734.e: My soul and body are totally Yours, Lord; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, my Primal Lord God.

734.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
734.t: dhaasan dhaas kahai jan naanak jehaa too(n) karaieh tehaa hau karee vakhiaan ||4||4||11||
734.e: So speaks servant Nanak, the slave of Your slaves; as You make me speak, so do I speak. ||4||4||11||

735.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੭
735.t: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar satvaa
735.e: Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Seventh House:

735.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
735.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
735.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

735.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
735.t: tere kavan kavan gun keh keh gaavaa too saahib gunee nidhaanaa ||
735.e: Which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing and recount, Lord? You are my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

735.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਊਚ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
735.t: tumaree mahimaa baran na saakau too(n) Thaakur uooch bhagavaanaa ||1||
735.e: I cannot express Your Glorious Praises. You are my Lord and Master, lofty and benevolent. ||1||

735.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
735.t: mai har har naam dhar soiee ||
735.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only support.

735.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
735.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh mere saahib mai tujh bin avar na koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
735.e: If it pleases You, please save me, O my Lord and Master; without You, I have no other at all. ||1||Pause||

735.g: ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
735.t: mai taan dheebaan toohai mere suaamee mai tudh aagai aradhaas ||
735.e: You alone are my strength, and my Court, O my Lord and Master; unto You alone I pray.

735.g: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
735.t: mai hor thaau naahee jis peh karau bena(n)tee meraa dhukh sukh tujh hee paas ||2||
735.e: There is no other place where I can offer my prayers; I can tell my pains and pleasures only to You. ||2||

735.g: ਵਿਚੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
735.t: viche dharatee viche paanee vich kaasaT agan dhareejai ||
735.e: Water is locked up in the earth, and fire is locked up in wood.

735.g: ਬਕਰੀ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਇਕਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
735.t: bakaree si(n)gh ikatai thai raakhe man har jap bhram bhau dhoor keejai ||3||
735.e: The sheep and the lions are kept in one place; O mortal, meditate on the Lord, and your doubts and fears shall be removed. ||3||

735.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ॥
735.t: har kee vaddiaaiee dhekhahu sa(n)tahu har nimaaniaa maan dhevaae ||
735.e: So behold the glorious greatness of the Lord, O Saints; the Lord blesses the dishonored with honor.

735.g: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
735.t: jiau dharatee charan tale te uoopar aavai tiau naanak saadh janaa jagat aan sabh pairee paae ||4||1||12||
735.e: As dust rises from underfoot, O Nanak, so does the Lord make all people fall at the feet of the Holy. ||4||1||12||

735.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
735.t: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
735.e: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

735.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
735.t: too(n) karataa sabh kichh aape jaaneh kiaa tudh peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
735.e: You Yourself, O Creator, know everything; what can I possibly tell You?

735.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
735.t: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai jehaa ko kare tehaa ko paieeaai ||1||
735.e: You know all the bad and the good; as we act, so are we rewarded. ||1||

735.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
735.t: mere saahib too(n) a(n)tar kee bidh jaaneh ||
735.e: O my Lord and Master, You alone know the state of my inner being.

735.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
735.t: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai tudh bhaavai tivai bulaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
735.e: You know all the bad and the good; as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ||1||Pause||

735.g: ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
735.t: sabh moh maiaa sareer har keeaa vich dhehee maanukh bhagat karaiee ||
735.e: The Lord has infused the love of Maya into all bodies; through this human body, there comes the opportunity to worship the Lord with devotion.

735.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
735.t: eikanaa satigur mel sukh dheveh ik manmukh dha(n)dh piTaiee ||2||
735.e: You unite some with the True Guru, and bless them with peace; while others, the self-willed manmukhs, are engrossed in worldly affairs. ||2||

735.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
735.t: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa mere karate tudh sabhanaa sir likhiaa lekh ||
735.e: All belong to You, and You belong to all, O my Creator Lord; You wrote the words of destiny on the forehead of everyone.

735.g: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
735.t: jehee too(n) nadhar kareh tehaa ko hovai bin nadharee naahee ko bhekh ||3||
735.e: As You bestow Your Glance of Grace, so are mortals made; without Your Gracious Glance, no one assumes any form. ||3||

735.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
735.t: teree vaddiaaiee too(n)hai jaaneh sabh tudhano nit dhiaae ||
735.e: You alone know Your Glorious Greatness; everyone constantly meditates on You.

735.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
735.t: jis no tudh bhaavai tis no too(n) meleh jan naanak so thai paae ||4||2||13||
735.e: That being, with whom You are pleased, is united with You; O servant Nanak, only such a mortal is accepted. ||4||2||13||

735.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
735.t: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
735.e: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

735.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
735.t: jin kai a(n)tar vasiaa meraa har har tin ke sabh rog gavaae ||
735.e: Those beings, within whose inner selves my Lord, Har, Har, dwells - all their diseases are cured.

735.g: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
735.t: te mukat bhe jin har naam dhiaaiaa tin pavit param padh paae ||1||
735.e: They alone become liberated, who meditate on the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status. ||1||

735.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਆਰੋਗ ਭਏ ॥
735.t: mere raam har jan aarog bhe ||
735.e: O my Lord, the Lord's humble servants become healthy.

735.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
735.t: gur bachanee jinaa japiaa meraa har har tin ke haumai rog ge ||1|| rahaau ||
735.e: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, are rid of the disease of ego. ||1||Pause||

735.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
735.t: brahamaa bisan mahaadheau trai gun rogee vich haumai kaar kamaiee ||
735.e: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva suffer from the disease of the three gunas - the three qualities; they do their deeds in egotism.

735.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
735.t: jin ke'ee tiseh na cheteh bapuRe har gurmukh sojhee paiee ||2||
735.e: The poor fools do not remember the One who created them; this understanding of the Lord is only obtained by those who become Gurmukh. ||2||

735.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
735.t: haumai rog sabh jagat biaapiaa tin kau janam maran dhukh bhaaree ||
735.e: The entire world is afflicted by the disease of egotism. They suffer the terrible pains of birth and death.

736.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
736.t: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa chhooTai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||3||
736.e: By Guru's Grace, a few rare ones are saved; I am a sacrifice to those humble beings. ||3||

736.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
736.t: jin sisaT saajee soiee har jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
736.e: The One who created the Universe, that Lord alone knows. His beauty is incomparable.

736.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
736.t: naanak aape vekh har bigasai gurmukh braham beechaaro ||4||3||14||
736.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself gazes upon it, and is pleased. The Gurmukh contemplates God. ||4||3||14||
Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

736.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੀਐ ॥
736.t: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaiee kichh keechai je kar sakeeaai ||
736.e: All that happens, and all that will happen, is by His Will. If we could do something by ourselves, we would.

736.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ॥੧॥
736.t: aapanaa keetaa kichhoo na hovai jiau har bhaavai tiau rakheeaai ||1||
736.e: By ourselves, we cannot do anything at all. As it pleases the Lord, He preserves us. ||1||

736.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
736.t: mere har jeeau sabh ko terai vas ||
736.e: O my Dear Lord, everything is in Your power.

736.g: ਅਸਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
736.t: asaa jor naahee je kichh kar ham saakeh jiau bhaavai tivai bakhas ||1|| rahaau ||
736.e: I have no power to do anything at all. As it pleases You, You forgive us. ||1||Pause||

736.g: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
736.t: sabh jeeau pi(n)dd dheeaa tudh aape tudh aape kaarai laiaa ||
736.e: You Yourself bless us with soul, body and everything. You Yourself cause us to act.

736.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
736.t: jehaa too(n) hukam kareh tehe ko karam kamaavai jehaa tudh dhur likh paiaa ||2||
736.e: As You issue Your Commands, so do we act, according to our pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

736.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
736.t: pa(n)ch tat kar tudh sirasaT sabh saajee koiee chhevaa kariau je kichh keetaa hovai ||
736.e: You created the entire Universe out of the five elements; if anyone can create a sixth, let him.

736.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
736.t: eikanaa satigur mel too(n) bujhaaveh ik manmukh kareh s rovai ||3||
736.e: You unite some with the True Guru, and cause them to understand, while others, the self-willed manmukhs, do their deeds and cry out in pain. ||3||

736.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨੀਚਾਣੁ ॥
736.t: har kee vaddiaaiee hau aakh na saakaa hau moorakh mugadh neechaan ||
736.e: I cannot describe the glorious greatness of the Lord; I am foolish, thoughtless, idiotic and lowly.

736.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਅਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
736.t: jan naanak kau har bakhas lai mere suaamee saranaagat piaa ajaan ||4||4||15||24||
736.e: Please, forgive servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I am ignorant, but I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||4||15||24||

736.t: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
736.e: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The actor stages the play,
playing the many characters in different costumes;
but when the play ends, he takes off the costumes,
and then he is one, and only one. ||1||
How many forms and images appeared and disappeared?

736.g: ਕਤਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
736.t: kateh gio uh kat te aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
736.e: Where have they gone? Where did they come from? ||1||Pause||
Countless waves rise up from the water.
Jewels and ornaments of many different forms are fashioned from gold.
I have seen seeds of all kinds being planted
- when the fruit ripens, the seeds appear in the same form as the original. ||2||
The one sky is reflected in thousands of water jugs,
but when the jugs are broken, only the sky remains.
Doubt comes from greed, emotional attachment and the corruption of Maya.
Freed from doubt, one realizes the One Lord alone. ||3||
He is imperishable; He will never pass away.

736.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
736.t: naa ko aavai naa ko jaahee ||
736.e: He does not come, and He does not go.
The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of ego.

736.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
736.t: kahu naanak meree param gat hoiee ||4||1||
736.e: Says Nanak, I have obtained the supreme status. ||4||1||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
Whatever God wills, that alone happens.
Without You, there is no other at all.

736.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
736.t: jo jan seve tis pooran kaaj ||
736.e: The humble being serves Him, and so all his works are perfectly successful.
O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slaves. ||1||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Merciful Lord.

736.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
736.t: tujh bin kavan kare pratipaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
736.e: Without You, who would cherish and love me? ||1||Pause||
He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.
God dwells near at hand; He is not far away.
By trying to please other people, nothing is accomplished.
When someone is attached to the True Lord, his ego is taken away. ||2||

737.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
737.t: jis no lai le so laagai ||
737.e: He alone is attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches.
The jewel of spiritual wisdom is awakened deep within.
Evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the supreme status is attained.
By Guru's Grace, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Pressing my palms together, I offer my prayer;
if it pleases You, Lord, please bless me and fulfill me.
Grant Your Mercy, Lord, and bless me with devotion.
Servant Nanak meditates on God forever. ||4||2||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
Blessed is that soul-bride, who realizes God.
She obeys the Hukam of His Order, and abandons her self-conceit.
Imbued with her Beloved, she celebrates in delight. ||1||
Listen, O my companions - these are the signs on the Path to meet God.

737.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
737.t: man tan arap taj laaj lokaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
737.e: Dedicate your mind and body to Him; stop living to please others. ||1||Pause||
One soul-bride counsels another,
to do only that which pleases God.
Such a soul-bride merges into the Being of God. ||2||
One who is in the grip of pride does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
She regrets and repents, when her life-night passes away.
The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||
I pray to God, but I think that He is far away.
God is imperishable and eternal; He is pervading and permeating everywhere.
Servant Nanak sings of Him; I see Him Ever-present everywhere. ||4||3||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

737.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਉ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
737.t: girahu vas gur keenaa hau ghar kee naar ||
737.e: The Giver has put this household of my being under my own control. I am now the mistress of the Lord's Home.
My Husband Lord has made the ten senses and organs of actions my slaves.

737.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋੜੀ ॥
737.t: sagal samagree mai ghar kee joRee ||
737.e: I have gathered together all the faculties and facilities of this house.
I am thirsty with desire and longing for my Husband Lord. ||1||
What Glorious Virtues of my Beloved Husband Lord should I describe?
He is All-knowing, totally beautiful and merciful; He is the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||
I am adorned with Truth, and I have applied the mascara of the Fear of God to my eyes.
I have chewed the betel-leaf of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.
My bracelets, robes and ornaments beautifully adorn me.

737.g: ਧਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
737.t: dhan sabh sukh paavai jaa(n) pir ghar aavai ||2||
737.e: The soul-bride becomes totally happy, when her Husband Lord comes to her home. ||2||
By the charms of virtue, I have enticed and fascinated my Husband Lord.

737.g: ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
737.t: vas kar leenaa gur bharam chukaiaa ||
737.e: He is under my power - the Guru has dispelled my doubts.
My mansion is lofty and elevated.

737.g: ਸਭ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
737.t: sabh kaaman tiaagee priau preetam meraa ||3||
737.e: Renouncing all other brides, my Beloved has become my lover. ||3||
The sun has risen, and its light shines brightly.
I have prepared my bed with infinite care and faith.

737.g: ਨਵ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲੁ ਸੇਜ ਰਾਵਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
737.t: nav ra(n)g laal sej raavan aaiaa ||
737.e: My Darling Beloved is new and fresh; He has come to my bed to enjoy me.

737.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
737.t: jan naanak pir dhan mil sukh paiaa ||4||4||
737.e: O Servant Nanak, my Husband Lord has come; the soul-bride has found peace. ||4||4||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
An intense yearning to meet God has welled up in my heart.
I have gone out searching to find my Beloved Husband Lord.

737.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
737.t: sunat sadhesaro pria gireh sej vichhaiee ||
737.e: Hearing news of my Beloved, I have laid out my bed in my home.

737.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
737.t: bhram bhram aaio tau nadhar na paiee ||1||
737.e: Wandering, wandering all around, I came, but I did not even see Him. ||1||
How can this poor heart be comforted?

737.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
737.t: mil saajan hau tujh kurabaano ||1|| rahaau ||
737.e: Come and meet me, O Friend; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
One bed is spread out for the bride and her Husband Lord.
The bride is asleep, while her Husband Lord is always awake.
The bride is intoxicated, as if she has drunk wine.
The soul-bride only awakens when her Husband Lord calls to her. ||2||
She has lost hope - so many days have passed.
I have travelled through all the lands and the countries.

738.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
738.t: khin rahan na paavau bin pag paage ||
738.e: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without the feet of my Beloved.
When God becomes Merciful, I become fortunate, and then I meet Him. ||3||
Becoming Merciful, He has united me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
The fire has been quenched, and I have found my Husband Lord within my own home.
I am now adorned with all sorts of decorations.
Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ||4||

738.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
738.t: jeh dhekhaa teh pir hai bhaiee ||
738.e: Wherever I look, I see my Husband Lord there, O Siblings of Destiny.

738.g: ਖੋਲਿੑਓ ਕਪਾਟੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
738.t: kholi(h)o kapaaT taa man Thaharaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||5||
738.e: When the door is opened, then the mind is restrained. ||1||Second Pause||5||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

738.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
738.t: kiaa gun tere saar sam(h)aalee moh niragun ke dhaataare ||
738.e: What virtues and excellences of Yours should I cherish and contemplate? I am worthless, while You are the Great Giver.

738.g: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
738.t: bai khareedh kiaa kare chaturaiee ih jeeau pi(n)dd sabh thaare ||1||
738.e: I am Your slave - what clever tricks could I ever try? This soul and body are totally Yours||1||

738.g: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
738.t: laal ra(n)geele preetam manmohan tere dharasan kau ham baare ||1|| rahaau ||
738.e: O my Darling, Blissful Beloved, who fascinates my mind - I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

738.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
738.t: prabh dhaataa moh dheen bhekhaaree tum(h) sadhaa sadhaa upakaare ||
738.e: O God, You are the Great Giver, and I am just a poor beggar; You are forever and ever benevolent.

738.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
738.t: so kichh naahee j mai te hovai mere Thaakur agam apaare ||2||
738.e: I cannot accomplish anything by myself, O my Unapproachable and Infinite Lord and Master. ||2||

738.g: ਕਿਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥
738.t: kiaa sev kamaavau kiaa keh reejhaavau bidh kit paavau dharasaare ||
738.e: What service can I perform? What should I say to please You? How can I gain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan?

738.g: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਸੈ ਚਰਨਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
738.t: mit nahee paieeaai a(n)t na laheeaai man tarasai charanaare ||3||
738.e: Your extent cannot be found - Your limits cannot be found. My mind longs for Your Feet. ||3||

738.g: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਢੀਠੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਰੇ ॥
738.t: paavau dhaan ddeeTh hoi maagau mukh laagai sa(n)t renaare ||
738.e: I beg with persistence to receive this gift, that the dust of the Saints might touch my face.

738.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
738.t: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree prabh haath dhei nisataare ||4||6||
738.e: The Guru has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; reaching out with His Hand, God has delivered him. ||4||6||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
His service is insignificant, but his demands are very great.
He does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he says that he has arrived there||1||

738.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸਾ ॥
738.t: jo pria maane tin kee reesaa ||
738.e: He competes with those who have been accepted by the Beloved Lord.
This is how stubborn the false fool is! ||1||Pause||
He wears religious robes, but he does not practice Truth.
He says that he has found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he cannot even get near it. ||2||
He says that he is unattached, but he is intoxicated with Maya.

738.g: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
738.t: man nahee preet kahai mukh raataa ||3||
738.e: There is no love in his mind, and yet he says that he is imbued with the Lord. ||3||
Says Nanak, hear my prayer, God:
I am silly, stubborn and filled with sexual desire - please, liberate me! ||4||
I gaze upon the glorious greatness of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

738.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੭॥
738.t: tum(h) sukhadhaate purakh subhaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||7||
738.e: You are the Giver of Peace, the Loving Primal Being. ||1||Second Pause||1||7||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
He gets up early, to do his evil deeds,

738.g: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਸੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
738.t: naam kee belaa pai pai soiaa ||1||
738.e: but when it is time to meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then he sleeps. ||1||
The ignorant person does not take advantage of the opportunity.
He is attached to Maya, and engrossed in worldly delights. ||1||Pause||

738.g: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
738.t: lobh lahar kau bigas fool baiThaa ||
738.e: He rides the waves of greed, puffed up with joy.

738.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
738.t: saadh janaa kaa dharas na ddeeThaa ||2||
738.e: He does not see the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||2||
The ignorant clown will never understand.
Again and again, he becomes engrossed in entanglements. ||1||Pause||
He listens to the sounds of sin and the music of corruption, and he is pleased.

738.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਲਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
738.t: har jas sunat aalas man keenaa ||3||
738.e: His mind is too lazy to listen to the Praises of the Lord. ||3||
You do not see with your eyes - you are so blind!

738.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
738.t: chhodd jaeh jhooThe sabh dha(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
738.e: You shall have to leave all these false affairs. ||1||Pause||
Says Nanak, please forgive me, God.

739.e: Have Mercy upon me, and bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||

739.g: ਤਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਹੋਈਐ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
739.t: tau kichh paieeaai jau hoieeaai renaa ||
739.e: He alone obtains something, who becomes the dust under the feet of all.

739.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨॥੮॥
739.t: jiseh bujhaae tis naam lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||2||8||
739.e: And he alone repeats the Naam, whom God causes to understand. ||1||Pause||2||8||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

739.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
739.t: ghar meh Thaakur nadhar na aavai ||
739.e: Within the home of his own self, he does not even come to see his Lord and Master.
And yet, around his neck, he hangs a stone god. ||1||
The faithless cynic wanders around, deluded by doubt.

739.g: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
739.t: neer birolai khap khap marataa ||1|| rahaau ||
739.e: He churns water, and after wasting his life away, he dies. ||1||Pause||
That stone, which he calls his god,

739.g: ਓਹੁ ਪਾਹਣੁ ਲੈ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਡੁਬਤਾ ॥੨॥
739.t: oh paahan lai us kau ddubataa ||2||
739.e: that stone pulls him down and drowns him. ||2||
O sinner, you are untrue to your own self;
a boat of stone will not carry you across. ||3||
Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I know my Lord and Master.
The Perfect Architect of Destiny is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky. ||4||3||9||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
How have you enjoyed your Dear Beloved?
O sister, please teach me, please show me. ||1||

739.g: ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਵੀ ॥ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
739.t: soohab soohab soohavee || apane preetam kai ra(n)g ratee ||1|| rahaau ||
739.e: Crimson, crimson, crimson - this is the color of the soul-bride who is imbued with the Love of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||
I wash Your Feet with my eye-lashes.
Wherever You send me, there I will go. ||2||

739.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
739.t: jap tap sa(n)jam dheau jatee ree ||
739.e: I would trade meditation, austerity, self-discipline and celibacy,

739.g: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
739.t: eik nimakh milaavahu moh praanapatee ree ||3||
739.e: if I could only meet the Lord of my life, for even an instant. ||3||
She who eradicates her self-conceit, power and arrogant intellect,
O Nanak, is the true soul-bride. ||4||4||10||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
You are my Life, the very Support of my breath of life.

739.g: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
739.t: tujh hee pekh pekh man saadhaaraa ||1||
739.e: Gazing upon You, beholding You, my mind is soothed and comforted. ||1||
You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.

739.g: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
739.t: chiteh na bisareh kaahoo beraa ||1|| rahaau ||
739.e: I shall never forget You. ||1||Pause||
I am Your indentured servant; I am Your slave.
You are my Great Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence. ||2||
There are millions of servants in Your Court - Your Royal Darbaar.
Each and every instant, You dwell with them. ||3||

739.g: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
739.t: hau kichh naahee sabh kichh teraa ||
739.e: I am nothing; everything is Yours.
Through and through, You abide with Nanak. ||4||5||11||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

739.g: ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
739.t: sookh mahal jaa ke uooch dhuaare ||
739.e: His Mansions are so comfortable, and His gates are so lofty.
Within them, His beloved devotees dwell. ||1||

739.g: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
739.t: sahaj kathaa prabh kee at meeThee ||
739.e: The Natural Speech of God is so very sweet.
How rare is that person, who sees it with his eyes. ||1||Pause||
There, in the arena of the congregation, the divine music of the Naad, the sound current, is sung.
There, the Saints celebrate with their Lord. ||2||

739.g: ਤਹ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ ॥
739.t: teh maran na jeevan sog na harakhaa ||
739.e: Neither birth nor death is there, neither pain nor pleasure.
The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name rains down there. ||3||

739.g: ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
739.t: guhaj kathaa ieh gur te jaanee ||
739.e: From the Guru, I have come to know the mystery of this speech.
Nanak speaks the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||12||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

739.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
739.t: jaa kai dharas paap koT utaare ||
739.e: By the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, millions of sins are erased.
Meeting with them, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed over||1||
They are my companions, and they are my dear friends,

739.g: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
739.t: jo ham kau har naam chitaare ||1|| rahaau ||
739.e: who inspire me to remember the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

739.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
739.t: jaa kaa sabadh sunat sukh saare ||
739.e: Hearing the Word of His Shabad, I am totally at peace.
When I serve Him, the Messenger of Death is chased away. ||2||

739.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥
739.t: jaa kee dheerak is maneh sadhaare ||
739.e: His comfort and consolation soothes and supports my mind.
Remembering Him in meditation, my face is radiant and bright. ||3||

739.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
739.t: prabh ke sevak prabh aap savaare ||
739.e: God embellishes and supports His servants.
Nanak seeks the Protection of their Sanctuary; he is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||7||13||

740.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

740.g: ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
740.t: rahan na paaveh sur nar dhevaa ||
740.e: The angelic beings and demi-gods are not permitted to remain here.

740.g: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
740.t: uooTh sidhaare kar mun jan sevaa ||1||
740.e: The silent sages and humble servants also must arise and depart. ||1||

740.g: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੇਖੇ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
740.t: jeevat pekhe jin(h)ee har har dhiaaiaa ||
740.e: Only those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, are seen to live on.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||
Kings, emperors and merchants must die.
Whoever is seen shall be consumed by death. ||2||
Mortal beings are entangled, clinging to false worldly attachments.
And when they must leave them behind, then they regret and grieve. ||3||

740.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
740.t: kirapaa nidhaan naanak kau karahu dhaat ||
740.e: O Lord, O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with this gift,
that he may chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||8||14||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
You dwell deep within the heart of each and every being.
The entire universe is strung on Your Thread. ||1||
You are my Beloved, the Support of my breath of life.

740.g: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
740.t: tum hee pekh pekh man bigasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
740.e: Beholding You, gazing upon You, my mind blossoms forth. ||1||Pause||

740.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
740.t: anik jon bhram bhram bhram haare ||
740.e: Wandering, wandering, wandering through countless incarnations, I have grown so weary.
Now, I hold tight to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||
You are inaccessible, incomprehensible, invisible and infinite.
Nanak remembers You in meditation, day and night. ||3||9||15||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
What is the use of the glory of Maya?

740.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
740.t: jaa kau binasat baar na kaiee ||1||
740.e: It disappears in no time at all. ||1||
This is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.
In his unconscious state, he clings to it. ||1||Pause||
The poor fool is enticed by the great attachments of the world.
Gazing upon them, watching them, he must still arise and depart. ||2||

740.g: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
740.t: uooch te uooch taa kaa dharabaaraa ||
740.e: The Royal Court of His Darbaar is the highest of the high.
He creates and destroys countless beings. ||3||
There has never been any other, and there shall never be.
O Nanak, meditate on the One God. ||4||10||16||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

740.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
740.t: simar simar taa kau hau jeevaa ||
740.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live.

740.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
740.t: charan kamal tere dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
740.e: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in the wash water. ||1||
He is my Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

740.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
740.t: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
740.e: My Lord and Master abides with His humble devotees. ||1||Pause||
Hearing, hearing Your Ambrosial Naam, I meditate on it.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||2||
Beholding, beholding Your divine play, my mind is in bliss.
Your Glorious Virtues are infinite, O God, O Lord of supreme bliss. ||3||

740.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
740.t: jaa kai simaran kachh bhau na biaapai ||
740.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, fear cannot touch me.
Forever and ever, Nanak meditates on the Lord. ||4||11||17||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

740.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
740.t: gur kai bachan ridhai dhiaan dhaaree ||
740.e: Within my heart, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Teachings.
With my tongue, I chant the Chant of the Lord. ||1||
The image of His vision is fruitful; I am a sacrifice to it.

740.g: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
740.t: charan kamal man praan adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
740.e: His Lotus Feet are the Support of the mind, the Support of the very breath of life. ||1||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the cycle of birth and death is ended.
To hear the Ambrosial Sermon is the support of my ears. ||2||
I have renounced sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
I have enshrined the Naam within myself, with charity, true cleansing and righteous conduct. ||3||
Says Nanak, I have contemplated this essence of reality;
chanting the Name of the Lord, I am carried across. ||4||12||18||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
The sinner is absorbed in greed and emotional attachment.

741.e: He has not performed any service to the Creator Lord. ||1||
O God, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.
I am worthless - please save me! ||1||Pause||
O God, You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
The body of the egotistical human is perishable. ||2||
Tastes and pleasures, conflicts and jealousy, and intoxication with Maya

741.g: ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
741.t: ein sa(n)g laag ratan janam gavaiaa ||3||
741.e: - attached to these, the jewel of human life is wasted. ||3||
The Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of pain, the Life of the world.
Forsaking everything, Nanak has entered His Sanctuary. ||4||13||19||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

741.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਅੰਧਾ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
741.t: pekhat chaakhat kaheeat a(n)dhaa suneeat suneeaai naahee ||
741.e: He sees with his eyes, but he is called blind; he hears, but he does not hear.

741.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
741.t: nikaT vasat kau jaanai dhoore paapee paap kamaahee ||1||
741.e: And the One who dwells near at hand, he thinks that He is far away; the sinner is committing sins. ||1||

741.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
741.t: so kichh kar jit chhuTeh paraanee ||
741.e: Do only those deeds which will save you, O mortal being.

741.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
741.t: har har naam jap a(n)mirat baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
741.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||
You are forever imbued with the love of horses and mansions.
Nothing shall go along with you. ||2||
You may clean and decorate the vessel of clay,
but it is so very filthy; it shall receive its punishment from the Messenger of Death. ||3||
You are bound by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
You are sinking down into the great pit. ||4||
Hear this prayer of Nanak, O Lord;
I am a stone, sinking down - please, rescue me! ||5||14||20||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
One who remains dead while yet alive understands God.
He meets that humble being according to the karma of his past actions. ||1||
Listen, O friend - this is how to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

741.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
741.t: mil saadhoo har naam uchareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
741.e: Meet with the Holy, and chant the Lord's Name||1||Pause||
There is no other to know, except for the One Lord.
So realize that the Supreme Lord God is within each and every heart. ||2||

741.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
741.t: jo kichh karai soiee bhal maanai ||
741.e: Whatever He does, accept that as good.
Know the value of the beginning and the end. ||3||
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being,
within whose heart the Lord dwells. ||4||15||21||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Creator Lord.
He gives His Support to the entire Universe. ||1||

741.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
741.t: gur ke charan kamal man dhiaai ||
741.e: Meditate within your mind on the Lotus Feet of the Guru.

741.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
741.t: dhookh dharadh is tan te jai ||1|| rahaau ||
741.e: Pain and suffering shall leave this body. ||1||Pause||
The True Guru saves the drowning being from the terrifying world-ocean.
He reunites those who were separated for countless incarnations. ||2||

741.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
741.t: gur kee sevaa karahu dhin raat ||
741.e: Serve the Guru, day and night.
Your mind shall come to have peace, pleasure and poise. ||3||
By great good fortune, one obtains the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

741.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੨॥
741.t: naanak gur kau sadh bal jaavai ||4||16||22||
741.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||4||16||22||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

741.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
741.t: aaTh pahar har har jas gaieeaai ||1||
741.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Meditate in remembrance on God, your Lord and Master.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||
So love the Lord's Lotus Feet,
and live a lifestyle which is true, perfect and spotless. ||2||
By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind,
and the sins of countless incarnations are eradicated. ||3||
Please be Merciful, O God, O Merciful to the meek.
Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||17||23||

742.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.
My karma is perfect, O my God. ||1||
Please, listen to this prayer, O my God.

742.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
742.t: dheh naam kar apane chere ||1|| rahaau ||
742.e: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me Your chaylaa, Your disciple. ||1||Pause||
Please keep me under Your Protection, O God, O Great Giver.
By Guru's Grace, a few people understand this. ||2||
Please hear my prayer, O God, my Friend.
May Your Lotus Feet abide within my consciousness. ||3||
Nanak makes one prayer:
may I never forget You, O perfect treasure of virtue. ||4||18||24||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
He is my friend, companion, child, relative and sibling.

742.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
742.t: jat kat pekhau har sa(n)g sahaiee ||1||
742.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord as my companion and helper. ||1||

742.g: ਜਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
742.t: jat meree pat meree dhan har naam ||
742.e: The Lord's Name is my social status, my honor and wealth.
He is my pleasure, poise, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||
I have strapped on the armor of meditation on the Supreme Lord God.
It cannot be pierced, even by millions of weapons. ||2||

742.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
742.t: har charan saran gaR koT hamaarai ||
742.e: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet is my fortress and battlement.

742.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
742.t: kaal ka(n)Tak jam tis na bidhaarai ||3||
742.e: The Messenger of Death, the torturer, cannot demolish it. ||3||
Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice
to the selfless servants and Saints of the Sovereign Lord, the Destroyer of ego. ||4||19||25||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

742.g: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
742.t: gun gopaal prabh ke nit gaahaa ||
742.e: Where the Glorious Praises of God, the Lord of the world are continually sung,
there is bliss, joy, happiness and peace. ||1||
Come, O my companions - let us go and enjoy God.

742.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
742.t: saadh janaa kee charanee paahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
742.e: Let us fall at the feet of the holy, humble beings. ||1||Pause||
I pray for the dust of the feet of the humble.
It shall wash away the sins of countless incarnations. ||2||
I dedicate my mind, body, breath of life and soul to God.

742.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਾਹਾਂ ॥੩॥
742.t: har simar simar maan moh kaTaahaa(n) ||3||
742.e: Remembering the Lord in meditation, I have eradicated pride and emotional attachment. ||3||
O Lord, O Merciful to the meek, please give me faith and confidence,
so that slave Nanak may remain absorbed in Your Sanctuary. ||4||20||26||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
The city of heaven is where the Saints dwell.

742.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
742.t: prabh charan kamal ridh maeh nivaasaa ||1||
742.e: They enshrine the Lotus Feet of God within their hearts. ||1||

742.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
742.t: sun man tan tujh sukh dhikhalaavau ||
742.e: Listen, O my mind and body, and let me show you the way to find peace,

742.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
742.t: har anik bi(n)jan tujh bhog bhu(n)chaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
742.e: so that you may eat and enjoy the various delicacies of the Lord||1||Pause||
Taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind.

742.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਸਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
742.t: acharaj saadh taa ke barane na jaahee ||2||
742.e: Its taste is wondrous - it cannot be described. ||2||
Your greed shall die, and your thirst shall be quenched.
The humble beings seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

742.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
742.t: janam janam ke bhai moh nivaare ||
742.e: The Lord dispels the fears and attachments of countless incarnations.
God has showered His Mercy and Grace upon slave Nanak. ||4||21||27||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
God covers the many shortcomings of His slaves.
Granting His Mercy, God makes them His own. ||1||
You emancipate Your humble servant,

742.g: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
742.t: aurajh pario jaal jag supanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
742.e: and rescue him from the noose of the world, which is just a dream. ||1||Pause||
Even huge mountains of sin and corruption
are removed in an instant by the Merciful Lord. ||2||
Sorrow, disease and the most terrible calamities
are removed by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He attaches us to the hem of His robe.

743.e: Grasping the Lord's Feet, O Nanak, we enter His Sanctuary. ||4||22||28||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
One who withdraws from God's Path, and attaches himself to the world,
is known as a sinner in both worlds. ||1||
He alone is approved, who pleases the Lord.
Only He Himself knows His creative omnipotence. ||1||Pause||
One who practices truth, righteous living, charity and good deeds,

743.g: ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਤੋਸੈ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
743.t: dheen kai tosai dhunee na jaae ||2||
743.e: has the supplies for God's Path. Worldly success shall not fail him. ||2||
Within and among all, the One Lord is awake.

743.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
743.t: jit jit laiaa tit tit ko laagai ||3||
743.e: As He attaches us, so are we attached. ||3||
You are inaccessible and unfathomable, O my True Lord and Master.
Nanak speaks as You inspire him to speak. ||4||23||29||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
In the early hours of the morning, I chant the Lord's Name.
I have fashioned a shelter for myself, here and hereafter. ||1||
Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name,

743.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
743.t: pooran hoveh man ke kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
743.e: and the desires of my mind are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
Sing the Praises of the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God, night and day.
In life, and in death, you shall find your eternal, unchanging home. ||2||

743.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
743.t: so saahu sev jit toT na aavai ||
743.e: So serve the Sovereign Lord, and you shall never lack anything.
While eating and consuming, you shall pass your life in peace. ||3||
O Life of the World, O Primal Being, I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||24||30||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
When the Perfect Guru becomes merciful,
my pains are taken away, and my works are perfectly completed. ||1||
Gazing upon, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live;
I am a sacrifice to Your Lotus Feet.

743.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
743.t: tujh bin Thaakur kavan hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
743.e: Without You, O my Lord and Master, who belongs to me? ||1||Pause||
I have fallen in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
by the karma of my past actions and my pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

743.g: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
743.t: jap har har naam acharaj parataap ||
743.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; how wondrous is His glory!
The three types of illness cannot consume it. ||3||

743.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
743.t: nimakh na bisareh har charan tum(h)aare ||
743.e: May I never forget, even for an instant, the Lord's Feet.
Nanak begs for this gift, O my Beloved. ||4||25||31||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
May there be such an auspicious time, O my Beloved,
when, with my tongue, I may chant the Lord's Name||1||
Hear my prayer, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

743.g: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
743.t: saadh gaaveh gun sadhaa rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
743.e: The Holy Saints ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||1||Pause||
Your meditation and remembrance is life-giving, God.

743.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
743.t: jis kirapaa kareh baseh tis neraa ||2||
743.e: You dwell near those upon whom You show mercy. ||2||

743.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਹਾਰੁ ॥
743.t: jan kee bhookh teraa naam ahaar ||
743.e: Your Name is the food to satisfy the hunger of Your humble servants.
You are the Great Giver, O Lord God. ||3||
The Saints take pleasure in repeating the Lord's Name.
O Nanak, the Lord, the Great Giver, is All-knowing. ||4||26||32||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

743.g: ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
743.t: bahatee jaat kadhe dhirasaT na dhaarat ||
743.e: Your life is slipping away, but you never even notice.
You are constantly entangled in false attachments and conflicts. ||1||
Meditate, vibrate constantly, day and night, on the Lord.

743.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
743.t: janam padhaarath jeet har saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
743.e: You shall be victorious in this priceless human life, in the Protection of the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

743.g: ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਤ ॥ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਰਤ ॥੨॥
743.t: karat bikaar dhouoo kar jhaarat || raam ratan ridh til nahee dhaarat ||2||
743.e: You eagerly commit sins and practice corruption, but you do not enshrine the jewel of the Lord's Name within your heart, even for an instant. ||2||
Feeding and pampering your body, your life is passing away,

744.g: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
744.t: jai jagadhees kee gat nahee jaanee ||3||
744.e: but you do not experience the state of victory of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||
So enter the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Unfathomable Lord and Master.
O God, O Searcher of hearts, please, save Nanak! ||4||27||33||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
Cross over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||
Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, I live.

744.g: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
744.t: dhookh rog sog sabh binase gur poore mil paap tajain ||1|| rahaau ||
744.e: All pain, disease and suffering is dispelled, meeting the Perfect Guru; sin has been eradicated. ||1||Pause||
The immortal status is obtained through the Name of the Lord;
the mind and body become spotless and pure, which is the true purpose of life. ||2||
Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Supreme Lord God.
By pre-ordained destiny, the Name is obtained. ||3||
I have entered His Sanctuary, and I meditate on the Lord, Merciful to the meek.
Nanak longs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||28||34||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

744.g: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
744.t: ghar kaa kaaj na jaanee rooRaa ||
744.e: The beautiful one does not know the work of his own home.
The fool is engrossed in false attachments. ||1||

744.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
744.t: jit too(n) laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
744.e: As You attach us, so we are attached.

744.g: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
744.t: jaa too(n) dheh teraa naau japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
744.e: When You bless us with Your Name, we chant it. ||1||Pause||

744.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
744.t: har ke dhaas har setee raate ||
744.e: The Lord's slaves are imbued with the Love of the Lord.
They are intoxicated with the Lord, night and day. ||2||
Reaching out to grasp hold of our arms, God lifts us up.
Separated for countless incarnations, we are united with Him again. ||3||
Save me, O God, O my Lord and Master - shower me with Your Mercy.
Slave Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door, O Lord. ||4||29||35||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.
I have found total peace, and I shall not waver again. ||1||

744.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
744.t: guroo dhiaai har charan man cheen(h)e ||
744.e: I meditate on the Guru, and the Lord's Feet, within my mind.

744.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
744.t: taa te karatai asathir keen(h)e ||1|| rahaau ||
744.e: In this way, the Creator Lord has made me steady and stable. ||1||Pause||
I sing the Glorious Praises of the unchanging, eternal Lord God,

744.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
744.t: taa te kaaTee jam kee faasee ||2||
744.e: and the noose of death is snapped. ||2||
Showering His Mercy, he has attached me to the hem of His robe.
In constant bliss, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||3||30||36||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
The Words, the Teachings of the Holy Saints, are Ambrosial Nectar.

744.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
744.t: jo jo japai tis kee gat hovai har har naam nit rasan bakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
744.e: Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is emancipated; he chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ||1||Pause||
The pains and sufferings of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga are eradicated,
when the One Name abides within the mind. ||1||
I apply the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead.
Nanak has been saved, in the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord. ||2||31||37||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla: Third House:
I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Merciful Lord.
Please, bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||Pause||
Please, grant Your Grace, and cherish me.
My soul and body are all Your property. ||1||
Only meditation on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, will go along with you.
Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||2||32||38||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

744.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
744.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
744.e: Without Him, there is no other at all.
The True Lord Himself is our anchor. ||1||
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is our only support.
The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful and Infinite. ||1||Pause||
He has eradicated all illness, and healed me.
O Nanak, He Himself has become my Savior. ||2||33||39||

745.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
745.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
745.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

745.g: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
745.t: dharasan kau lochai sabh koiee ||
745.e: Everyone longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

745.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
745.t: poorai bhaag paraapat hoiee || rahaau ||
745.e: By perfect destiny, it is obtained. ||Pause||

745.g: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਨੀਦ ਕਿਉ ਆਈ ॥
745.t: siaam su(n)dhar taj needh kiau aaiee ||
745.e: Forsaking the Beautiful Lord, how can they go to sleep?

745.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਦੂਤਾ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
745.t: mahaa mohanee dhootaa laiee ||1||
745.e: The great enticer Maya has led them down the path of sin. ||1||

745.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
745.t: prem bichhohaa karat kasaiee ||
745.e: This butcher has separated them from the Beloved Lord.

745.g: ਨਿਰਦੈ ਜੰਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
745.t: niradhai ja(n)t tis dhiaa na paiee ||2||
745.e: This merciless one shows no mercy at all to the poor beings. ||2||

745.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬੀਤੀਅਨ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
745.t: anik janam beeteean bharamaiee ||
745.e: Countless lifetimes have passed away, wandering aimlessly.

745.g: ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
745.t: ghar vaas na dhevai dhutar maiee ||3||
745.e: The terrible, treacherous Maya does not even allow them to dwell in their own home. ||3||

745.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
745.t: dhin rain apanaa keeaa paiee ||
745.e: Day and night, they receive the rewards of their own actions.

745.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਭਵਾਈ ॥੪॥
745.t: kis dhos na dheejai kirat bhavaiee ||4||
745.e: Don't blame anyone else; your own actions lead you astray. ||4||

745.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
745.t: sun saajan sa(n)t jan bhaiee ||
745.e: Listen, O Friend, O Saint, O humble Sibling of Destiny:

745.g: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੦॥
745.t: charan saran naanak gat paiee ||5||34||40||
745.e: in the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found Salvation. ||5||34||40||

745.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
745.t: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
745.e: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

745.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
745.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
745.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

745.g: ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
745.t: bhalee suhaavee chhaaparee jaa meh gun gaae ||
745.e: Even a crude hut is sublime and beautiful, if the Lord's Praises are sung within it.

745.g: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
745.t: kit hee kaam na dhaulahar jit har bisaraae ||1|| rahaau ||
745.e: Those mansions where the Lord is forgotten are useless. ||1||Pause||

745.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
745.t: anadh gareebee saadhasa(n)g jit prabh chit aae ||
745.e: Even poverty is bliss, if God comes to mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

745.g: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
745.t: jal jaau eh baddapanaa maiaa lapaTaae ||1||
745.e: This worldly glory might just as well burn; it only traps the mortals in Maya. ||1||

745.g: ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਓਢਿ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ ॥
745.t: peesan pees odd kaamaree sukh man sa(n)tokhaae ||
745.e: One may have to grind corn, and wear a coarse blanket, but still, one can find peace of mind and contentment.

745.g: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
745.t: aaiso raaj na kitai kaaj jit neh tirapataae ||2||
745.e: Even empires are of no use at all, if they do not bring satisfaction. ||2||

745.g: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
745.t: nagan firat ra(n)g ek kai oh sobhaa paae ||
745.e: Someone may wander around naked, but if he loves the One Lord, he receives honor and respect.

745.g: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਰਚਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
745.t: paaT paTa(n)bar birathiaa jeh rach lobhaae ||3||
745.e: Silk and satin clothes are worthless, if they lead to greed. ||3||

745.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
745.t: sabh kichh tum(h)rai haath prabh aap kare karaae ||
745.e: Everything is in Your Hands, God. You Yourself are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

745.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
745.t: saas saas simarat rahaa naanak dhaan paae ||4||1||41||
745.e: With each and every breath, may I continue to remember You. Please, bless Nanak with this gift. ||4||1||41||

745.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
745.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
745.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

745.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
745.t: har kaa sa(n)t paraan dhan tis kaa panihaaraa ||
745.e: The Lord's Saint is my life and wealth. I am his water-carrier.

745.g: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
745.t: bhaiee meet sut sagal te jeea hoo(n) te piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
745.e: He is dearer to me than all my siblings, friends and children. ||1||Pause||

745.g: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
745.t: kesaa kaa kar beejanaa sa(n)t chaur ddulaavau ||
745.e: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over the Saint.

745.g: ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਚਰਣ ਤਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
745.t: sees nihaarau charan tal dhoor mukh laavau ||1||
745.e: I bow my head low, to touch his feet, and apply his dust to my face. ||1||

745.g: ਮਿਸਟ ਬਚਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
745.t: misaT bachan benatee karau dheen kee niaaiee ||
745.e: I offer my prayer with sweet words, in sincere humility.

745.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
745.t: taj abhimaan saranee parau har gun nidh paiee ||2||
745.e: Renouncing egotism, I enter His Sanctuary. I have found the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||2||

745.g: ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
745.t: avalokan puneh puneh karau jan kaa dharasaar ||
745.e: I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant, again and again.

745.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਉ ਬੰਦਉ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
745.t: a(n)mirat bachan man meh si(n)chau ba(n)dhau baar baar ||3||
745.e: I cherish and gather in His Ambrosial Words within my mind; time and time again, I bow to Him. ||3||

745.g: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ ॥
745.t: chitavau man aasaa karau jan kaa sa(n)g maagau ||
745.e: In my mind, I wish, hope and beg for the Society of the Lord's humble servants.

745.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੨॥
745.t: naanak kau prabh dhiaa kar dhaas charanee laagau ||4||2||42||
745.e: Be Merciful to Nanak, O God, and lead him to the feet of Your slaves. ||4||2||42||

745.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
745.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
745.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

745.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
745.t: jin mohe brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd taahoo meh paau ||
745.e: She has enticed the worlds and solar systems; I have fallen into her clutches.

745.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
745.t: raakh leh ih bikhiee jeeau dheh apunaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
745.e: O Lord, please save this corrupt soul of mine; please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

745.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
745.t: jaa te naahee ko sukhee taa kai paachhai jaau ||
745.e: She has not brought anyone peace, but still, I chase after her.

745.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਉ ॥੧॥
745.t: chhodd jaeh jo sagal kau fir fir lapaTaau ||1||
745.e: She forsakes everyone, but still, I cling to her, again and again. ||1||

745.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
745.t: karahu kirapaa karunaapate tere har gun gaau ||
745.e: Have Mercy on me, O Lord of Compassion; please let me sing Your Glorious Praises, O Lord.

745.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੩॥
745.t: naanak kee prabh benatee saadhasa(n)g samaau ||2||3||43||
745.e: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord, that he may join and merge with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||43||

746.t: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa paRataal
746.e: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House, Partaal:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Love of the enticing Beloved Lord is the most glorious love.

746.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਏਕੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਛਾਡੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
746.t: jap man gobi(n)dh ekai avar nahee ko lekhai sa(n)t laag maneh chhaadd dhubidhaa kee kureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
746.e: Meditate, O mind, on the One Lord of the Universe - nothing else is of any account. Attach your mind to the Saints, and abandon the path of duality. ||1||Pause||

746.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਹਰੀਆ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
746.t: niragun hareeaa saragun dhareeaa anik koThareeaa bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhin kareeaa ||
746.e: The Lord is absolute and unmanifest; He has assumed the most sublime manifestation. He has fashioned countless body chambers of many, varied, different, myriad forms.
Within them, the mind is the policeman;
my Beloved lives in the temple of my inner self.
He plays there in ecstasy.
He does not die, and he never grows old. ||1||

746.g: ਕਿਰਤਨਿ ਜੁਰੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੀਆ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਹਿਰੀਆ ॥
746.t: kiratan jureeaa bahu bidh fireeaa par kau hireeaa ||
746.e: He is engrossed in worldly activities, wandering around in various ways. He steals the property of others,
and is surrounded by corruption and sin.
But now, he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
and stands before the Lord's Gate.
He obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
Nanak has met the Guru;
he shall not be reincarnated again. ||2||1||44||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord has made this world a stage;
He fashioned the expanse of the entire creation. ||1||Pause||
He fashioned it in various ways, with limitless colors and forms.
He watches over it with joy, and He never tires of enjoying it.
He enjoys all the delights, and yet He remains unattached. ||1||

746.g: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
746.t: baran chihan naahee mukh na maasaaraa ||
746.e: He has no color, no sign, no mouth and no beard.
I cannot describe Your play.
Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||45||
Soohee, Fifth Mehla:
I have come to You. I have come to Your Sanctuary.
I have come to place my faith in You. I have come seeking Mercy.

746.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
746.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee maarag gureh paThaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
746.e: If it pleases You, save me, O my Lord and Master. The Guru has placed me upon the Path. ||1||Pause||

746.g: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
746.t: mahaa dhutar maiaa || jaise pavan jhulaiaa ||1||
746.e: Maya is very treacherous and difficult to pass through. It is like a violent wind-storm. ||1||
I am so afraid to hear
that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is so strict and stern. ||2||
The world is a deep, dark pit;
it is all on fire. ||3||
I have grasped the Support of the Holy Saints.
Nanak meditates on the Lord.
Now, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||4||3||46||

746.t: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa
746.e: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

746.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
746.t: satigur paas bena(n)teeaa milai naam aadhaaraa ||
746.e: I offer this prayer to the True Guru, to bless me with the sustenance of the Naam.

746.g: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
746.t: tuThaa sachaa paatisaahu taap giaa sa(n)saaraa ||1||
746.e: When the True King is pleased, the world is rid of its diseases. ||1||

746.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
746.t: bhagataa kee Tek too(n) sa(n)taa kee oT too(n) sachaa sirajanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
746.e: You are the Support of Your devotees, and the Shelter of the Saints, O True Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

746.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
746.t: sach teree saamagaree sach teraa dharabaaraa ||
746.e: True are Your devices, and True is Your Court.

746.g: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਖਾਜੀਨਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
746.t: sach tere khaajeeniaa sach teraa paasaaraa ||2||
746.e: True are Your treasures, and True is Your expanse. ||2||

746.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਾਰਾ ॥
746.t: teraa roop aga(n)m hai anoop teraa dharasaaraa ||
746.e: Your Form is inaccessible, and Your Vision is incomparably beautiful.

746.g: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
746.t: hau kurabaanee teriaa sevakaa jin(h) har naam piaaraa ||3||
746.e: I am a sacrifice to Your servants; they love Your Name, O Lord. ||3||

747.g: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
747.t: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa jaa paiaa agam apaaraa ||
747.e: All desires are fulfilled, when the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is obtained.

747.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਚਰਣਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
747.t: gur naanak miliaa paarabraham teriaa charanaa kau balihaaraa ||4||1||47||
747.e: Guru Nanak has met the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to Your Feet. ||4||1||47||

747.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
747.t: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
747.e: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

747.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
747.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
747.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

747.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
747.t: teraa bhaanaa toohai manaieh jis no hoh dhiaalaa ||
747.e: He alone obeys Your Will, O Lord, unto whom You are Merciful.

747.g: ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
747.t: saiee bhagat jo tudh bhaavai too(n) sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
747.e: That alone is devotional worship, which is pleasing to Your Will. You are the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||

747.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
747.t: mere raam rai sa(n)taa Tek tum(h)aaree ||
747.e: O my Sovereign Lord, You are the Support of the Saints.

747.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
747.t: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan man tan toohai adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
747.e: Whatever pleases You, they accept. You are the sustenance of their minds and bodies. ||1||Pause||

747.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
747.t: too(n) dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh manasaa pooranahaaraa ||
747.e: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of our hopes.

747.g: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
747.t: bhagat tere sabh praanapat preetam too(n) bhagatan kaa piaaraa ||2||
747.e: You are the Beloved Lord of life of all Your devotees; You are the Beloved of Your devotees. ||2||

747.g: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
747.t: too athaahu apaar at uoochaa koiee avar na teree bhaate ||
747.e: You are unfathomable, infinite, lofty and exalted. There is no one else like You.

747.g: ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
747.t: eeh aradhaas hamaaree suaamee visar naahee sukhadhaate ||3||
747.e: This is my prayer, O my Lord and Master; may I never forget You, O Peace-giving Lord. ||3||

747.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
747.t: dhin rain saas saas gun gaavaa je suaamee tudh bhaavaa ||
747.e: Day and night, with each and every breath, I sing Your Glorious Praises, if it is pleasing to Your Will.

747.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
747.t: naam teraa sukh naanak maagai saahib tuThai paavaa ||4||1||48||
747.e: Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name, O Lord and Master; as it is pleasing to Your Will, I shall attain it. ||4||1||48||

747.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
747.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
747.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

747.g: ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
747.t: visareh naahee jit too kabahoo so thaan teraa kehaa ||
747.e: Where is that place, where You are never forgotten, Lord?

747.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧॥
747.t: aaTh pahar jit tudh dhiaaiee niramal hovai dhehaa ||1||
747.e: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate on You, and their bodies become spotless and pure. ||1||

747.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
747.t: mere raam hau so thaan bhaalan aaiaa ||
747.e: O my Lord, I have come searching for that place.

747.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
747.t: khojat khojat bhiaa saadhasa(n)g tin(h) saranaiee paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
747.e: After seeking and searching, I found Sanctuary in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

747.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
747.t: bedh paRe paR brahame haare ik til nahee keemat paiee ||
747.e: Reading and reciting the Vedas, Brahma grew weary, but he did not find even a tiny bit of God's worth.

747.g: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਭੀ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
747.t: saadhik sidh fireh bilalaate te bhee mohe maiee ||2||
747.e: The seekers and Siddhas wander around bewailing; they too are enticed by Maya. ||2||

747.g: ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
747.t: dhas aautaar raaje hoi varate mahaadhev aaudhootaa ||
747.e: There were ten regal incarnations of Vishnu; and then there was Shiva, the renunciate.

747.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
747.t: tin(h) bhee a(n)t na paio teraa lai thake bibhootaa ||3||
747.e: He did not find Your limits either, although he grew weary of smearing his body with ashes. ||3||

747.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
747.t: sahaj sookh aana(n)dh naam ras har sa(n)tee ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
747.e: Peace, poise and bliss are found in the subtle essence of the Naam. The Lord's Saints sing the songs of joy.

747.g: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
747.t: safal dharasan bheTio gur naanak taa man tan har har dhiaaiaa ||4||2||49||
747.e: I have obtained the Fruitful Vision of Guru Nanak's Darshan, and with my mind and body I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||49||

747.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
747.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
747.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

747.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਲੂਟੈ ॥
747.t: karam dharam paakha(n)dd jo dheeseh tin jam jaagaatee looTai ||
747.e: The religious rites, rituals and hypocrisies which are seen, are plundered by the Messenger of Death, the ultimate tax collector.

747.g: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥
747.t: nirabaan keeratan gaavahu karate kaa nimakh simarat jit chhooTai ||1||
747.e: In the state of Nirvaanaa, sing the Kirtan of the Creator's Praises; contemplating Him in meditation, even for an instant, one is saved. ||1||

747.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
747.t: sa(n)tahu saagar paar utareeaai ||
747.e: O Saints, cross over the world-ocean.

747.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
747.t: je ko bachan kamaavai sa(n)tan kaa so gur parasaadhee tareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
747.e: One who practices the Teachings of the Saints, by Guru's Grace, is carried across. ||1||Pause||

747.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
747.t: koT teerath majan isanaanaa is kal meh mail bhareejai ||
747.e: Millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage only fill the mortal with filth in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

747.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
747.t: saadhasa(n)g jo har gun gaavai so niramal kar leejai ||2||
747.e: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, becomes spotlessly pure. ||2||

747.g: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਇਨੑ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
747.t: bedh kateb simirat sabh saasat in(h) paRiaa mukat na hoiee ||
747.e: One may read all the books of the Vedas, the Bible, the Simritees and the Shaastras, but they will not bring liberation.

747.g: ਏਕੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
747.t: ek akhar jo gurmukh jaapai tis kee niramal soiee ||3||
747.e: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the One Word, acquires a spotlessly pure reputation. ||3||

747.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ ॥
747.t: khatree braahaman soodh vais upadhes chahu varanaa kau saajhaa ||
747.e: The four castes - the Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas - are equal in respect to the teachings.

748.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਝਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
748.t: gurmukh naam japai udharai so kal meh ghaT ghaT naanak maajhaa ||4||3||50||
748.e: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is saved. In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, God is permeating the hearts of each and every being. ||4||3||50||

748.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
748.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
748.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

748.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
748.t: jo kichh karai soiee prabh maaneh oi raam naam ra(n)g raate ||
748.e: Whatever God causes to happen is accepted, by those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord's Name.

748.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
748.t: tin(h) kee sobhaa sabhanee thaiee jin(h) prabh ke charan paraate ||1||
748.e: Those who fall at the Feet of God are respected everywhere. ||1||

748.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
748.t: mere raam har sa(n)taa jevadd na koiee ||
748.e: O my Lord, no one is as great as the Lord's Saints.

748.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
748.t: bhagataa ban aaiee prabh apane siau jal thal maheeal soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
748.e: The devotees are in harmony with their God; He is in the water, the land, and the sky. ||1||Pause||

748.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
748.t: koT apraadhee sa(n)tasa(n)g udharai jam taa kai neR na aavai ||
748.e: Millions of sinners have been saved in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

748.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
748.t: janam janam kaa bichhuRiaa hovai tin(h) har siau aan milaavai ||2||
748.e: Those who have been separated from the Lord, for countless incarnations, are reunited with the Lord again. ||2||

748.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ॥
748.t: maiaa moh bharam bhau kaaTai sa(n)t saran jo aavai ||
748.e: Attachment to Maya, doubt and fear are eradicated, when one enters the Sanctuary of the Saints.

748.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
748.t: jehaa manorath kar aaraadhe so sa(n)tan te paavai ||3||
748.e: Whatever wishes one harbors, are obtained from the Saints. ||3||

748.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
748.t: jan kee mahimaa ketak baranau jo prabh apane bhaane ||
748.e: How can I describe the glory of the Lord's humble servants? They are pleasing to their God.

748.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
748.t: kahu naanak jin satigur bheTiaa se sabh te bhe nikaane ||4||4||51||
748.e: Says Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, become independent of all obligations. ||4||4||51||

748.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
748.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
748.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

748.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
748.t: mahaa agan te tudh haath dhe raakhe pe teree saranaiee ||
748.e: Giving me Your Hand, You saved me from the terrible fire, when I sought Your Sanctuary.

748.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
748.t: teraa maan taan ridh a(n)tar hor dhoojee aas chukaiee ||1||
748.e: Deep within my heart, I respect Your strength; I have abandoned all other hopes. ||1||

748.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ਉਬਰੇ ॥
748.t: mere raam rai tudh chit aaiaai ubare ||
748.e: O my Sovereign Lord, when You enter my consciousness, I am saved.

748.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
748.t: teree Tek bharavaasaa tum(h)raa jap naam tum(h)aaraa udhare ||1|| rahaau ||
748.e: You are my support. I count on You. Meditating on You, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

748.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
748.t: a(n)dh koop te kaadd le'ee tum(h) aap bhe kirapaalaa ||
748.e: You pulled me up out of the deep, dark pit. You have become merciful to me.

748.g: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
748.t: saar sam(h)aal sarab sukh dhe'ee aap kare pratipaalaa ||2||
748.e: You care for me, and bless me with total peace; You Yourself cherish me. ||2||

748.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
748.t: aapanee nadhar kare paramesar ba(n)dhan kaaT chhaddaae ||
748.e: The Transcendent Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace; breaking my bonds, He has delivered me.

748.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
748.t: aapanee bhagat prabh aap karaiee aape sevaa laae ||3||
748.e: God Himself inspires me to worship Him; He Himself inspires me to serve Him. ||3||

748.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ ॥
748.t: bharam giaa bhai moh binaase miTiaa sagal visooraa ||
748.e: My doubts have gone, my fears and infatuations have been dispelled, and all my sorrows are gone.

748.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
748.t: naanak dhiaa karee sukhadhaatai bheTiaa satigur pooraa ||4||5||52||
748.e: O Nanak, the Lord, the Giver of peace has been merciful to me. I have met the Perfect True Guru. ||4||5||52||

748.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
748.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
748.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

748.g: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
748.t: jab kachh na seeo tab kiaa karataa kavan karam kar aaiaa ||
748.e: When nothing existed, what deeds were being done? And what karma caused anyone to be born at all?

748.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
748.t: apanaa khel aap kar dhekhai Thaakur rachan rachaiaa ||1||
748.e: The Lord Himself set His play in motion, and He Himself beholds it. He created the Creation. ||1||

748.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
748.t: mere raam rai mujh te kachhoo na hoiee ||
748.e: O my Sovereign Lord, I cannot do anything at all by myself.

748.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
748.t: aape karataa aap karaae sarab nira(n)tar soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
748.e: He Himself is the Creator, He Himself is the Cause. He is pervading deep within all. ||1||Pause||

748.g: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
748.t: ganatee ganee na chhooTai katahoo kaachee dheh iaanee ||
748.e: If my account were to be judged, I would never be saved. My body is transitory and ignorant.

748.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
748.t: kirapaa karahu prabh karanaihaare teree bakhas niraalee ||2||
748.e: Take pity upon me, O Creator Lord God; Your Forgiving Grace is singular and unique. ||2||

748.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
748.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh tere keete ghaT ghaT tuhee dhiaaieeaai ||
748.e: You created all beings and creatures. Each and every heart meditates on You.

748.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
748.t: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kudharat keem na paieeaai ||3||
748.e: Your condition and expanse are known only to You; the value of Your creative omnipotence cannot be estimated. ||3||

748.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
748.t: niragun mugadh ajaan agiaanee karam dharam nahee jaanaa ||
748.e: I am worthless, foolish, thoughtless and ignorant. I know nothing about good actions and righteous living.

748.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੩॥
748.t: dhiaa karahu naanak gun gaavai miThaa lagai teraa bhaanaa ||4||6||53||
748.e: Take pity on Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; and that Your Will may seem sweet to him. ||4||6||53||

748.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
748.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
748.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

749.g: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
749.t: bhaagaThaRe har sa(n)t tum(h)aare jin(h) ghar dhan har naamaa ||
749.e: Your Saints are very fortunate; their homes are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Name.

749.g: ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਣੀ ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
749.t: paravaan ganee seiee ieh aae safal tinaa ke kaamaa ||1||
749.e: Their birth is approved, and their actions are fruitful. ||1||

749.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
749.t: mere raam har jan kai hau bal jaiee ||
749.e: O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the humble servants of the Lord.

749.g: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
749.t: kesaa kaa kar chavar ddulaavaa charan dhooR mukh laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
749.e: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over them; I apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||1||Pause||

749.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਆਏ ॥
749.t: janam maran dhuhahoo meh naahee jan paraupakaaree aae ||
749.e: Those generous, humble beings are above both birth and death.

749.g: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
749.t: jeea dhaan dhe bhagatee lain har siau lain milaae ||2||
749.e: They give the gift of the soul, and practice devotional worship; they inspire others to meet the Lord. ||2||

749.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
749.t: sachaa amar sachee paatisaahee sache setee raate ||
749.e: True are their commands, and true are their empires; they are attuned to the Truth.

749.g: ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
749.t: sachaa sukh sachee vaddiaaiee jis ke se tin jaate ||3||
749.e: True is their happiness, and true is their greatness. They know the Lord, to whom they belong. ||3||

749.g: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
749.t: pakhaa feree paanee ddovaa har jan kai peesan pees kamaavaa ||
749.e: I wave the fan over them, carry water for them, and grind corn for the humble servants of the Lord.

749.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
749.t: naanak kee prabh paas bena(n)tee tere jan dhekhan paavaa ||4||7||54||
749.e: Nanak offers this prayer to God - please, grant me the sight of Your humble servants. ||4||7||54||

749.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
749.t: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
749.e: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

749.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
749.t: paarabraham paramesar satigur aape karanaihaaraa ||
749.e: The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Creator Lord.

749.g: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
749.t: charan dhooR teree sevak maagai tere dharasan kau balihaaraa ||1||
749.e: Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

749.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
749.t: mere raam rai jiau raakheh tiau raheeaai ||
749.e: O my Sovereign Lord, as You keep me, so do I remain.

749.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
749.t: tudh bhaavai taa naam japaaveh sukh teraa dhitaa laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
749.e: When it pleases You, I chant Your Name. You alone can grant me peace. ||1||Pause||

749.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
749.t: mukat bhugat jugat teree sevaa jis too(n) aap karaieh ||
749.e: Liberation, comfort and proper lifestyle come from serving You; You alone cause us to serve You.

749.g: ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇਹਿ ॥੨॥
