When you are seized by the neck, then you shall cry out.

792.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਆਗੇ ਤੇ ਨ ਸੰਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
792.t: keh kabeer aage te na sa(n)m(h)aaraa ||3||1||
792.e: Says Kabeer, why didn't you remember the Lord before this? ||3||1||
Soohee, Kabeer Jee:
My innocent soul trembles and shakes.
I do not know how my Husband Lord will deal with me. ||1||

792.g: ਰੈਨਿ ਗਈ ਮਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
792.t: rain giee mat dhin bhee jai ||
792.e: The night of my youth has passed away; will the day of old age also pass away?

792.g: ਭਵਰ ਗਏ ਬਗ ਬੈਠੇ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
792.t: bhavar ge bag baiThe aai ||1|| rahaau ||
792.e: My dark hairs, like bumble bees, have gone away, and grey hairs, like cranes, have settled upon my head. ||1||Pause||
Water does not remain in the unbaked clay pot;
when the soul-swan departs, the body withers away. ||2||
I decorate myself like a young virgin;
but how can I enjoy pleasures, without my Husband Lord? ||3||
My arm is tired, driving away the crows.
Says Kabeer, this is the way the story of my life ends. ||4||2||
Soohee, Kabeer Jee:
Your time of service is at its end, and you will have to give your account.
The hard-hearted Messenger of Death has come to take you away.
What have you earned, and what have you lost?
Come immediately! You are summoned to His Court! ||1||
Get going! Come just as you are! You have been summoned to His Court.

792.g: ਹਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
792.t: har furamaan dharageh kaa aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
792.e: The Order has come from the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I pray to the Messenger of Death: please, I still have some outstanding debts to collect in the village.
I will collect them tonight;
I will also pay you something for your expenses,
and I will recite my morning prayers on the way. ||2||

792.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
792.t: saadhasa(n)g jaa kau har ra(n)g laagaa || dhan dhan so jan purakh sabhaagaa ||
792.e: Blessed, blessed is the most fortunate servant of the Lord, who is imbued with the Lord's Love, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Here and there, the humble servants of the Lord are always happy.
They win the priceless treasure of this human life. ||3||
When he is awake, he is sleeping, and so he loses this life.
The property and wealth he has accumulated passes on to someone else.
Says Kabeer, those people are deluded,
who forget their Lord and Master, and roll in the dust. ||4||3||

793.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
793.t: soohee kabeer jeeau lalit ||
793.e: Soohee, Kabeer Jee, Lallit:

793.g: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
793.t: thaake nain sravan sun thaake thaakee su(n)dhar kaiaa ||
793.e: My eyes are exhausted, and my ears are tired of hearing; my beautiful body is exhausted.

793.g: ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਏਕ ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
793.t: jaraa haak dhee sabh mat thaakee ek na thaakas maiaa ||1||
793.e: Driven forward by old age, all my senses are exhausted; only my attachment to Maya is not exhausted. ||1||

793.g: ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
793.t: baavare tai giaan beechaar na paiaa ||
793.e: O mad man, you have not obtained spiritual wisdom and meditation.

793.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
793.t: birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
793.e: You have wasted this human life, and lost. ||1||Pause||

793.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
793.t: tab lag praanee tisai sarevahu jab lag ghaT meh saasaa ||
793.e: O mortal, serve the Lord, as long as the breath of life remains in the body.

793.g: ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
793.t: je ghaT jai ta bhaau na jaasee har ke charan nivaasaa ||2||
793.e: And even when your body dies, your love for the Lord shall not die; you shall dwell at the Feet of the Lord. ||2||

793.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
793.t: jis kau sabadh basaavai a(n)tar chookai tiseh piaasaa ||
793.e: When the Word of the Shabad abides deep within, thirst and desire are quenched.

793.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
793.t: hukamai boojhai chaupaR khelai man jin ddaale paasaa ||3||
793.e: When one understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he plays the game of chess with the Lord; throwing the dice, he conquers his own mind. ||3||

793.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
793.t: jo jan jaan bhajeh abigat kau tin kaa kachhoo na naasaa ||
793.e: Those humble beings, who know the Imperishable Lord and meditate on Him, are not destroyed at all.

793.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
793.t: kahu kabeer te jan kabahu na haareh ddaal ju jaaneh paasaa ||4||4||
793.e: Says Kabeer, those humble beings who know how to throw these dice, never lose the game of life. ||4||4||

793.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
793.t: soohee lalit kabeer jeeau ||
793.e: Soohee, Lalit, Kabeer Jee:

793.g: ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
793.t: ek koT pa(n)ch sikadhaaraa pa(n)che maageh haalaa ||
793.e: In the one fortress of the body, there are five rulers, and all five demand payment of taxes.

793.g: ਜਿਮੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
793.t: jimee naahee mai kisee kee boiee aaisaa dhen dhukhaalaa ||1||
793.e: I have not farmed anyone's land, so such payment is difficult for me to pay. ||1||

793.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
793.t: har ke logaa mo kau neet ddasai paTavaaree ||
793.e: O people of the Lord, the tax-collector is constantly torturing me!

793.g: ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
793.t: uoopar bhujaa kar mai gur peh pukaariaa tin hau leeaa ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
793.e: Raising my arms up, I complained to my Guru, and He has saved me. ||1||Pause||

793.g: ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
793.t: nau ddaaddee dhas mu(n)saf dhaaveh rieeat basan na dhehee ||
793.e: The nine tax-assessors and the ten magistrates go out; they do not allow their subjects to live in peace.

793.g: ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
793.t: ddoree pooree maapeh naahee bahu bisaTaalaa lehee ||2||
793.e: They do not measure with a full tape, and they take huge amounts in bribes. ||2||

793.g: ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
793.t: bahatar ghar ik purakh samaiaa un dheeaa naam likhaiee ||
793.e: The One Lord is contained in the seventy-two chambers of the body, and He has written off my account.

793.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
793.t: dharam rai kaa dhafatar sodhiaa baakee rijam na kaiee ||3||
793.e: The records of the Righteous Judge of Dharma have been searched, and I owe absolutely nothing. ||3||

793.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
793.t: sa(n)taa kau mat koiee ni(n)dhahu sa(n)t raam hai ekuo ||
793.e: Let no one slander the Saints, because the Saints and the Lord are as one.

793.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
793.t: kahu kabeer mai so gur paiaa jaa kaa naau bibekuo ||4||5||
793.e: Says Kabeer, I have found that Guru, whose Name is Clear Understanding. ||4||5||

793.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
793.t: raag soohee baanee sree ravidhaas jeeau kee
793.e: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Sree Ravi Daas Jee:

793.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
793.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
793.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

793.g: ਸਹ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
793.t: seh kee saar suhaagan jaanai ||
793.e: The happy soul-bride knows the worth of her Husband Lord.

793.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
793.t: taj abhimaan sukh raleeaa maanai ||
793.e: Renouncing pride, she enjoys peace and pleasure.

793.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
793.t: tan man dhei na a(n)tar raakhai ||
793.e: She surrenders her body and mind to Him, and does not remain separate from Him.

793.g: ਅਵਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ ਅਭਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
793.t: avaraa dhekh na sunai abhaakhai ||1||
793.e: She does not see or hear, or speak to another. ||1||

793.g: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਜਾਨੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
793.t: so kat jaanai peer paraiee ||
793.e: How can anyone know the pain of another,

793.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
793.t: jaa kai a(n)tar dharadh na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
793.e: if there is no compassion and sympathy within? ||1||Pause||

793.g: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਹੀਨੀ ॥
793.t: dhukhee dhuhaagan dhui pakh heenee ||
793.e: The discarded bride is miserable, and loses both worlds;

793.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
793.t: jin naeh nira(n)tar bhagat na keenee ||
793.e: she does not worship her Husband Lord.

793.g: ਪੁਰ ਸਲਾਤ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
793.t: pur salaat kaa pa(n)th dhuhelaa ||
793.e: The bridge over the fire of hell is difficult and treacherous.

793.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਗਵਨੁ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
793.t: sa(n)g na saathee gavan ikelaa ||2||
793.e: No one will accompany you there; you will have to go all alone. ||2||

793.g: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦਰਦਵੰਦੁ ਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
793.t: dhukheeaa dharadhava(n)dh dhar aaiaa ||
793.e: Suffering in pain, I have come to Your Door, O Compassionate Lord.

793.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
793.t: bahut piaas jabaab na paiaa ||
793.e: I am so thirsty for You, but You do not answer me.

793.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
793.t: keh ravidhaas saran prabh teree ||
793.e: Says Ravi Daas, I seek Your Sanctuary, God;

793.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
793.t: jiau jaanahu tiau kar gat meree ||3||1||
793.e: as You know me, so will You save me. ||3||1||

793.g: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
793.t: soohee ||
793.e: Soohee:

793.g: ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
793.t: jo dhin aaveh so dhin jaahee ||
793.e: That day which comes, that day shall go.

793.g: ਕਰਨਾ ਕੂਚੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
793.t: karanaa kooch rahan thir naahee ||
793.e: You must march on; nothing remains stable.

793.g: ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
793.t: sa(n)g chalat hai ham bhee chalanaa ||
793.e: Our companions are leaving, and we must leave as well.

793.g: ਦੂਰਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
793.t: dhoor gavan sir uoopar maranaa ||1||
793.e: We must go far away. Death is hovering over our heads. ||1||

794.g: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਇਆ ਜਾਗੁ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
794.t: kiaa too soiaa jaag iaanaa ||
794.e: Why are you asleep? Wake up, you ignorant fool!

794.g: ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
794.t: tai jeevan jag sach kar jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
794.e: You believe that your life in the world is true. ||1||Pause||

794.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
794.t: jin jeeau dheeaa su rijak a(n)baraavai ||
794.e: The One who gave you life shall also provide you with nourishment.

794.g: ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹਾਟੁ ਚਲਾਵੈ ॥
794.t: sabh ghaT bheetar haaT chalaavai ||
794.e: In each and every heart, He runs His shop.

794.g: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
794.t: kar ba(n)dhigee chhaadd mai meraa ||
794.e: Meditate and renounce all concepts of "I am" and "Mine."

794.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
794.t: hiradhai naam sam(h)aar saveraa ||2||
794.e: Within your heart, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, sometime. ||2||

794.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸਵਾਰਾ ॥
794.t: janam siraano pa(n)th na savaaraa ||
794.e: Your life has passed away, but you have not arranged your path.

794.g: ਸਾਂਝ ਪਰੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
794.t: saa(n)jh paree dheh dhis a(n)dhiaaraa ||
794.e: Evening has set in, and soon there will be darkness on all sides.

794.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
794.t: keh ravidhaas nidhaan dhivaane ||
794.e: Says Ravi Daas, O ignorant mad-man,

794.g: ਚੇਤਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਨ ਖਾਨੇ ॥੩॥੨॥
794.t: chetas naahee dhuneeaa fan khaane ||3||2||
794.e: don't you realize, that this world is the house of death?! ||3||2||

794.g: ਸੂਹੀ ॥
794.t: soohee ||
794.e: Soohee:

794.g: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸਾਲ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
794.t: uooche ma(n)dhar saal rasoiee ||
794.e: You may have lofty mansions, halls and kitchens.

794.g: ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
794.t: ek gharee fun rahan na hoiee ||1||
794.e: But you cannot stay in them, even for an instant, after death. ||1||

794.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
794.t: eih tan aaisaa jaise ghaas kee TaaTee ||
794.e: This body is like a house of straw.

794.g: ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
794.t: jal gio ghaas ral gio maaTee ||1|| rahaau ||
794.e: When it is burnt, it mixes with dust. ||1||Pause||

794.g: ਭਾਈ ਬੰਧ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹੇਰਾ ॥ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਢੁ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
794.t: bhaiee ba(n)dh kuTa(n)b saheraa || oi bhee laage kaadd saveraa ||2||
794.e: Even relatives, family and friends begin to say, ""Take his body out, immediately!""||2||

794.g: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
794.t: ghar kee naar ureh tan laagee ||
794.e: And the wife of his house, who was so attached to his body and heart,

794.g: ਉਹ ਤਉ ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
794.t: auh tau bhoot bhoot kar bhaagee ||3||
794.e: runs away, crying out, ""Ghost! Ghost!""||3||

794.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਸਭੈ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ॥
794.t: keh ravidhaas sabhai jag looTiaa ||
794.e: Says Ravi Daas, the whole world has been plundered,

794.g: ਹਮ ਤਉ ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
794.t: ham tau ek raam keh chhooTiaa ||4||3||
794.e: but I have escaped, chanting the Name of the One Lord. ||4||3||

794.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
794.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
794.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

794.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
794.t: raag soohee baanee sekh fareedh jee kee ||
794.e: Raag Soohee, The Word Of Shaykh Fareed Jee:

794.g: ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
794.t: tap tap luh luh haath marorau ||
794.e: Burning and burning, writhing in pain, I wring my hands.

794.g: ਬਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਲੋਰਉ ॥
794.t: baaval hoiee so sahu lorau ||
794.e: I have gone insane, seeking my Husband Lord.

794.g: ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
794.t: tai seh man meh keeaa ros ||
794.e: O my Husband Lord, You are angry with me.

794.g: ਮੁਝੁ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੧॥
794.t: mujh avagan seh naahee dhos ||1||
794.e: The fault is with me, and not with my Husband Lord. ||1||

794.g: ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
794.t: tai saahib kee mai saar na jaanee ||
794.e: O my Lord and Master, I do not know Your excellence and worth.

794.g: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਖੋਇ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
794.t: joban khoi paachhai pachhutaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
794.e: Having wasted my youth, now I come to regret the past. ||1||Pause||

794.g: ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
794.t: kaalee koil too kit gun kaalee ||
794.e: O black bird, what qualities have made you black?

794.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
794.t: apane preetam ke hau birahai jaalee ||
794.e: "I have been burnt by separation from my Beloved."

794.g: ਪਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
794.t: pireh bihoon kateh sukh paae ||
794.e: Without her Husband Lord, how can the soul-bride ever find peace?

794.g: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
794.t: jaa hoi kirapaal taa prabhoo milaae ||2||
794.e: When He becomes merciful, then God unites us with Himself. ||2||

794.g: ਵਿਧਣ ਖੂਹੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਇਕੇਲੀ ॥
794.t: vidhan khoohee mu(n)dh ikelee ||
794.e: The lonely soul-bride suffers in the pit of the world.

794.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
794.t: naa ko saathee naa ko belee ||
794.e: She has no companions, and no friends.

794.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ॥
794.t: kar kirapaa prabh saadhasa(n)g melee ||
794.e: In His Mercy, God has united me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

794.g: ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
794.t: jaa fir dhekhaa taa meraa alahu belee ||3||
794.e: And when I look again, then I find God as my Helper. ||3||

794.g: ਵਾਟ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਖਰੀ ਉਡੀਣੀ ॥
794.t: vaaT hamaaree kharee uddeenee ||
794.e: The path upon which I must walk is very depressing.

794.g: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪਿਈਣੀ ॥
794.t: kha(n)niahu tikhee bahut pieenee ||
794.e: It is sharper than a two-edged sword, and very narrow.

794.g: ਉਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
794.t: aus uoopar hai maarag meraa ||
794.e: That is where my path lies.

794.g: ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
794.t: sekh fareedhaa pa(n)th sam(h)aar saveraa ||4||1||
794.e: O Shaykh Fareed, think of that path early on. ||4||1||

794.g: ਸੂਹੀ ਲਲਿਤ ॥
794.t: soohee lalit ||
794.e: Soohee, Lalit:

794.g: ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
794.t: beRaa ba(n)dh na sakio ba(n)dhan kee velaa ||
794.e: You were not able to make yourself a raft when you should have.

794.g: ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
794.t: bhar saravar jab uoochhalai tab taran dhuhelaa ||1||
794.e: When the ocean is churning and over-flowing, then it is very difficult to cross over it. ||1||

794.g: ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
794.t: hath na lai kasu(n)bhaRai jal jaasee ddolaa ||1|| rahaau ||
794.e: Do not touch the safflower with your hands; its color will fade away, my dear. ||1||Pause||

794.g: ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
794.t: eik aapeen(h)ai patalee seh kere bolaa ||
794.e: First, the bride herself is weak, and then, her Husband Lord's Order is hard to bear.

794.g: ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
794.t: dhudhaa thanee na aaviee fir hoi na melaa ||2||
794.e: Milk does not return to the breast; it will not be collected again. ||2||

794.g: ਕਹੈ ਫਰੀਦੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਅਲਾਏਸੀ ॥
794.t: kahai fareedh saheleeho sahu alaaesee ||
794.e: Says Fareed, O my companions, when our Husband Lord calls,

794.g: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
794.t: ha(n)s chalasee ddu(n)manaa eh tan dderee theesee ||3||2||
794.e: the soul-swan departs, sad at heart, and this body returns to dust. ||3||2||

795.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
795.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
795.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

795.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
795.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
795.e: Raag Bilaaval, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

795.g: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
795.t: too sulataan kahaa hau meeaa teree kavan vaddaiee ||
795.e: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?

795.g: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
795.t: jo too dheh su kahaa suaamee mai moorakh kahan na jaiee ||1||
795.e: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chant Your Praises. ||1||

795.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
795.t: tere gun gaavaa dheh bujhaiee ||
795.e: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

795.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
795.t: jaise sach meh rahau rajaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
795.e: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||

795.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
795.t: jo kichh hoaa sabh kichh tujh te teree sabh asanaiee ||
795.e: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.

795.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
795.t: teraa a(n)t na jaanaa mere saahib mai a(n)dhule kiaa chaturaiee ||2||
795.e: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do I have? ||2||

795.g: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
795.t: kiaa hau kathee kathe kath dhekhaa mai akath na kathanaa jaiee ||
795.e: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

795.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
795.t: jo tudh bhaavai soiee aakhaa til teree vaddiaaiee ||3||
795.e: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||

795.g: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਭਉਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
795.t: ete kookar hau begaanaa bhaukaa is tan taiee ||
795.e: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.

795.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
795.t: bhagat heen naanak je hoigaa taa khasamai naau na jaiee ||4||1||
795.e: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leave me. ||4||1||

795.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
795.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
795.e: Bilaawal, First Mehla:

795.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
795.t: man ma(n)dhar tan ves kala(n)dhar ghaT hee teerath naavaa ||
795.e: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deep within my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.

795.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
795.t: ek sabadh merai praan basat hai baahuR janam na aavaa ||1||
795.e: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||

795.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
795.t: man bedhiaa dhiaal setee meree maiee ||
795.e: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!

795.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
795.t: kaun jaanai peer paraiee ||
795.e: Who can know the pain of another?

795.g: ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
795.t: ham naahee chi(n)t paraiee ||1|| rahaau ||
795.e: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

795.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
795.t: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
795.e: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!

795.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
795.t: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa ghaT ghaT jot tum(h)aaree ||2||
795.e: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in each and every heart. ||2||

795.g: ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
795.t: sikh mat sabh budh tum(h)aaree ma(n)dhir chhaavaa tere ||
795.e: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions and sanctuaries are Yours as well.

795.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
795.t: tujh bin avar na jaanaa mere saahibaa gun gaavaa nit tere ||3||
795.e: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||

795.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
795.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh saran tum(h)aaree sarab chi(n)t tudh paase ||
795.e: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of their care rests with You.

795.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
795.t: jo tudh bhaavai soiee cha(n)gaa ik naanak kee aradhaase ||4||2||
795.e: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||

795.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
795.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
795.e: Bilaawal, First Mehla:

795.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੇ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
795.t: aape sabadh aape neesaan ||
795.e: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.

795.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
795.t: aape surataa aape jaan ||
795.e: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.

795.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
795.t: aape kar kar vekhai taan ||
795.e: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.

795.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
795.t: too dhaataa naam paravaan ||1||
795.e: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1||

796.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
796.t: aaisaa naam nira(n)jan dheau ||
796.e: Such is the Name of the Immaculate, Divine Lord.

796.g: ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
796.t: hau jaachik too alakh abheau ||1|| rahaau ||
796.e: I am just a beggar; You are invisible and unknowable. ||1||Pause||

796.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਧਰਕਟੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰਿ ॥
796.t: maiaa moh dharakaTee naar || bhoo(n)ddee kaaman kaamaniaar ||
796.e: Love of Maya is like a cursed woman, ugly, dirty and promiscuous.

796.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
796.t: raaj roop jhooThaa dhin chaar ||
796.e: Power and beauty are false, and last for only a few days.

796.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
796.t: naam milai chaanan a(n)dhiaar ||2||
796.e: But when one is blessed with the Naam, the darkness within is illuminated. ||2||

796.g: ਚਖਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
796.t: chakh chhoddee sahasaa nahee koi ||
796.e: I tasted Maya and renounced it, and now, I have no doubts.

796.g: ਬਾਪੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
796.t: baap dhisai vejaat na hoi ||
796.e: One whose father is known, cannot be illegitimate.

796.g: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
796.t: eke kau naahee bhau koi ||
796.e: One who belongs to the One Lord, has no fear.

796.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
796.t: karataa kare karaavai soi ||3||
796.e: The Creator acts, and causes all to act. ||3||

796.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਨੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
796.t: sabadh mue man man te maariaa ||
796.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad conquers his mind, through his mind.

796.g: ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
796.t: Thaak rahe man saachai dhaariaa ||
796.e: Keeping his mind restrained, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart.

796.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
796.t: avar na soojhai gur kau vaariaa ||
796.e: He does not know any other, and he is a sacrifice to the Guru.

796.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
796.t: naanak naam rate nisataariaa ||4||3||
796.e: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, he is emancipated. ||4||3||

796.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
796.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
796.e: Bilaaval, First Mehla:

796.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੇ ॥
796.t: gur bachanee man sahaj dhiaane ||
796.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the mind intuitively meditates on the Lord.

796.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
796.t: har kai ra(n)g rataa man maane ||
796.e: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mind is satisfied.

796.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਬਉਰਾਨੇ ॥
796.t: manmukh bharam bhule bauraane ||
796.e: The insane, self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded by doubt.

796.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
796.t: har bin kiau raheeaai gur sabadh pachhaane ||1||
796.e: Without the Lord, how can anyone survive? Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||1||

796.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
796.t: bin dharasan kaise jeevau meree maiee ||
796.e: Without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, how can I live, O my mother?

796.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
796.t: har bin jeearaa reh na sakai khin satigur boojh bujhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
796.e: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive, even for an instant; the True Guru has helped me understand this. ||1||Pause||

796.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
796.t: meraa prabh bisarai hau marau dhukhaalee ||
796.e: Forgetting my God, I die in pain.

796.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
796.t: saas giraas japau apune har bhaalee ||
796.e: With each breath and morsel of food, I meditate on my Lord, and seek Him.

796.g: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ॥
796.t: sadh bairaagan har naam nihaalee ||
796.e: I remain always detached, but I am enraptured with the Lord's Name.

796.g: ਅਬ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
796.t: ab jaane gurmukh har naalee ||2||
796.e: Now, as Gurmukh, I know that the Lord is always with me. ||2||

796.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
796.t: akath kathaa kaheeaai gur bhai ||
796.e: The Unspoken Speech is spoken, by the Will of the Guru.

796.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
796.t: prabh agam agochar dhei dhikhai ||
796.e: He shows us that God is unapproachable and unfathomable.

796.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
796.t: bin gur karanee kiaa kaar kamai ||
796.e: Without the Guru, what lifestyle could we practice, and what work could we do?

796.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
796.t: haumai meT chalai gur sabadh samai ||3||
796.e: Eradicating egotism, and walking in harmony with the Guru's Will, I am absorbed in the Word of the Shabad. ||3||

796.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
796.t: manmukh vichhuRai khoTee raas ||
796.e: The self-willed manmukhs are separated from the Lord, gathering false wealth.

796.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
796.t: gurmukh naam milai saabaas ||
796.e: The Gurmukhs are celebrated with the glory of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

796.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
796.t: har kirapaa dhaaree dhaasan dhaas ||
796.e: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon me, and made me the slave of His slaves.

796.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
796.t: jan naanak har naam dhan raas ||4||4||
796.e: The Name of the Lord is the wealth and capital of servant Nanak. ||4||4||

796.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
796.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
796.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, First House:

796.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
796.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
796.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

796.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
796.t: dhirag dhirag khaiaa dhirag dhirag soiaa dhirag dhirag kaapaR a(n)g chaRaiaa ||
796.e: Cursed, cursed is the food; cursed, cursed is the sleep; cursed, cursed are the clothes worn on the body.

796.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
796.t: dhirag sareer kuTa(n)b sahit siau jit hun khasam na paiaa ||
796.e: Cursed is the body, along with family and friends, when one does not find his Lord and Master in this life.

796.g: ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
796.t: pauRee chhuRakee fir haath na aavai ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||1||
796.e: He misses the step of the ladder, and this opportunity will not come into his hands again; his life is wasted, uselessly. ||1||

796.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
796.t: dhoojaa bhaau na dheiee liv laagan jin har ke charan visaare ||
796.e: The love of duality does not allow him to lovingly focus his attention on the Lord; he forgets the Feet of the Lord.

796.g: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
796.t: jagajeevan dhaataa jan sevak tere tin ke tai dhookh nivaare ||1|| rahaau ||
796.e: O Life of the World, O Great Giver, you eradicate the sorrows of your humble servants. ||1||Pause||

796.g: ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
796.t: too dhiaal dhiaapat dhaataa kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaare ||
796.e: You are Merciful, O Great Giver of Mercy; what are these poor beings?

796.g: ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
796.t: mukat ba(n)dh sabh tujh te hoe aaisaa aakh vakhaane ||
796.e: All are liberated or placed into bondage by You; this is all one can say.

796.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
796.t: gurmukh hovai so mukat kaheeaai manmukh ba(n)dh vichaare ||2||
796.e: One who becomes Gurmukh is said to be liberated, while the poor self-willed manmukhs are in bondage. ||2||

796.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
796.t: so jan mukat jis ek liv laagee sadhaa rahai har naale ||
796.e: He alone is liberated, who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Lord, always dwelling with the Lord.

796.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
796.t: tin kee gahan gat kahee na jaiee sachai aap savaare ||
796.e: His depth and condition cannot be described. The True Lord Himself embellishes him.

797.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
797.t: bharam bhulaane s manmukh kahe'eeh naa uravaar na paare ||3||
797.e: Those who wander around, deluded by doubt, are called manmukhs; they are neither on this side, nor on the other side. ||3||

797.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
797.t: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan paae gur kaa sabadh sam(h)aale ||
797.e: That humble being, who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains Him, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

797.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
797.t: har jan maiaa maeh nisataare ||
797.e: In the midst of Maya, the Lord's servant is emancipated.

797.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
797.t: naanak bhaag hovai jis masatak kaaleh maar bidhaare ||4||1||
797.e: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead, conquers and destroys death. ||4||1||

797.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
797.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
797.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

797.g: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
797.t: atul kiau toliaa jai ||
797.e: How can the unweighable be weighed?

797.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
797.t: dhoojaa hoi ta sojhee pai ||
797.e: If there is anyone else as great, then he alone could understand the Lord.

797.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
797.t: tis te dhoojaa naahee koi ||
797.e: There is no other than Him.

797.g: ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਕੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
797.t: tis dhee keemat kikoo hoi ||1||
797.e: How can His value be estimated? ||1||

797.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
797.t: gur parasaadh vasai man aai ||
797.e: By Guru's Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

797.g: ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
797.t: taa ko jaanai dhubidhaa jai ||1|| rahaau ||
797.e: One comes to know Him, when duality departs. ||1||Pause||

797.g: ਆਪਿ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
797.t: aap saraaf kasavaTee laae ||
797.e: He Himself is the Assayer, applying the touch-stone to test it.

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ॥
797.t: aape parakhe aap chalaae ||
797.e: He Himself analyzes the coin, and He Himself approves it as currency.

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
797.t: aape tole pooraa hoi ||
797.e: He Himself weights it perfectly.

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
797.t: aape jaanai eko soi ||2||
797.e: He alone knows; He is the One and Only Lord. ||2||

797.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
797.t: maiaa kaa roop sabh tis te hoi ||
797.e: All the forms of Maya emanate from Him.

797.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
797.t: jis no mele su niramal hoi ||
797.e: He alone becomes pure and immaculate, who is united with the Lord.

797.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
797.t: jis no laae lagai tis aai ||
797.e: He alone is attached, whom the Lord attaches.

797.g: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
797.t: sabh sach dhikhaale taa sach samai ||3||
797.e: All Truth is revealed to him, and then, he merges in the True Lord. ||3||

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
797.t: aape liv dhaat hai aape ||
797.e: He Himself leads the mortals to focus on Him, and He Himself causes them to chase after Maya.

797.g: ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
797.t: aap bujhaae aape jaape ||
797.e: He Himself imparts understanding, and He reveals Himself.

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ॥
797.t: aape satigur sabadh hai aape ||
797.e: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Word of the Shabad.

797.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
797.t: naanak aakh sunaae aape ||4||2||
797.e: O Nanak, He Himself speaks and teaches. ||4||2||

797.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
797.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
797.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

797.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: saahib te sevak sev saahib te kiaa ko kahai bahaanaa ||
797.e: My Lord and Master has made me His servant, and blessed me with His service; how can anyone argue about this?

797.g: ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
797.t: aaisaa ik teraa khel baniaa hai sabh meh ek samaanaa ||1||
797.e: Such is Your play, One and Only Lord; You are the One, contained among all. ||1||

797.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
797.t: satigur parachai har naam samaanaa || jis karam hovai so satigur paae anadhin laagai sahaj dhiaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
797.e: When the True Guru is pleased and appeased, one is absorbed in the Lord's Name. One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy, finds the True Guru; night and day, he automatically remains focused on the Lord's meditation. ||1||Pause||

797.g: ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: kiaa koiee teree sevaa kare kiaa ko kare abhimaanaa ||
797.e: How can I serve You? How can I be proud of this?

797.g: ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
797.t: jab apunee jot khi(n)cheh too suaamee tab koiee karau dhikhaa vakhiaanaa ||2||
797.e: When You withdraw Your Light, O Lord and Master, then who can speak and teach? ||2||

797.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape gunee nidhaanaa ||
797.e: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the humble disciple; You Yourself are the treasure of virtue.

797.g: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
797.t: jiau aap chalaae tivai koiee chaalai jiau har bhaavai bhagavaanaa ||3||
797.e: As You cause us to move, so do we move, according to the Pleasure of Your Will, O Lord God. ||3||

797.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
797.t: kahat naanak too saachaa saahib kaun jaanai tere kaamaa(n) ||
797.e: Says Nanak, You are the True Lord and Master; who can know Your actions?

797.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
797.t: eikanaa ghar meh dhe vaddiaaiee ik bharam bhaveh abhimaanaa ||4||3||
797.e: Some are blessed with glory in their own homes, while others wander in doubt and pride. ||4||3||

797.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
797.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa ||
797.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

797.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: pooraa thaaT banaiaa poorai vekhahu ek samaanaa ||
797.e: The perfect Lord has fashioned the Perfect Creation. Behold the Lord pervading everywhere.

797.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
797.t: eis parapa(n)ch meh saache naam kee vaddiaaiee mat ko dharahu gumaanaa ||1||
797.e: In this play of the world, is the glorious greatness of the True Name. No one should take pride in himself. ||1||

797.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: satigur kee jis no mat aavai so satigur maeh samaanaa ||
797.e: One who accepts the wisdom of the True Guru's Teachings, is absorbed into the True Guru.

797.g: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
797.t: eeh baanee jo jeeahu jaanai tis a(n)tar ravai har naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
797.e: The Lord's Name abides deep within the nucleus of one who realizes the Bani of the Guru's Word within his soul. ||1||Pause||

797.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: chahu jugaa kaa hun nibeRaa nar manukhaa no ek nidhaanaa ||
797.e: Now, this is the essence of the teachings of the four ages: for the human race, the Name of the One Lord is the greatest treasure.

797.g: ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
797.t: jat sa(n)jam teerath onaa jugaa kaa dharam hai kal meh keerat har naamaa ||2||
797.e: Celibacy, self-discipline and pilgrimages were the essence of Dharma in those past ages; but in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Praise of the Lord's Name is the essence of Dharma. ||2||

797.g: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
797.t: jug jug aapo aapanaa dharam hai sodh dhekhahu bedh puraanaa ||
797.e: Each and every age has its own essence of Dharma; study the Vedas and the Puraanas, and see this as true.

797.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਿ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
797.t: gurmukh jinee dhiaaiaa har har jag te poore paravaanaa ||3||
797.e: They are Gurmukh, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; in this world, they are perfect and approved. ||3||

798.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
798.t: kahat naanak sache siau preet laae chookai man abhimaanaa ||
798.e: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.

798.g: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
798.t: kahat sunat sabhe sukh paaveh maanat paeh nidhaanaa ||4||4||
798.e: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4||
Bilaaval, Third Mehla:

798.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
798.t: gurmukh preet jis no aape laae ||
798.e: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;

798.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
798.t: tit ghar bilaaval gur sabadh suhaae ||
798.e: joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The women come and sing the songs of joy.
Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

798.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
798.t: hau tin balihaarai jin(h) har ma(n)n vasaae ||
798.e: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

798.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
798.t: har jan kau miliaa sukh paieeaai har gun gaavai sahaj subhaae ||1|| rahaau ||
798.e: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;

798.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
798.t: har jeeau aap vasai man aae ||
798.e: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.
They obtain eternal glory.
The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.

798.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
798.t: nij ghar vaasaa har gun gaae ||
798.e: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.

798.g: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
798.t: eih ra(n)g kadhe na utarai saach samaae ||3||
798.e: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.
Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.

798.g: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
798.t: jo sach raate tin bahuR na feraa ||
798.e: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

798.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
798.t: naanak naam dhiraRaae pooraa gur meraa ||4||5||
798.e: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5||
Bilaaval, Third Mehla:
From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.
Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.

798.g: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
798.t: dhar saachai gur te sobhaa paiee ||1||
798.e: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

798.g: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
798.t: jagadhees sevau mai avar na kaajaa ||
798.e: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.

798.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
798.t: anadhin anadh hovai man merai gurmukh maagau teraa naam nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
798.e: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam. ||1||Pause||

798.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
798.t: man kee parateet man te paiee ||
798.e: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.
Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.
How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.

798.g: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
798.t: bahuR na marai naa jam pekhai ||2||
798.e: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||

798.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
798.t: ghar hee meh sabh koT nidhaan ||
798.e: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.
The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.
I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.
Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||
I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,
from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.
Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.
He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||
By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.
He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.

798.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
798.t: gur kaa sabadh at meeThaa laiaa ||
798.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.

798.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
798.t: naanak tirasan bujhee man tan sukh paiaa ||5||6||4||6||10||
798.e: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10||

798.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa
798.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

798.g: ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
798.t: audham mat prabh a(n)tarajaamee jiau prere tiau karanaa ||
798.e: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as He wills, they act.

798.g: ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
798.t: jiau naTooaa ta(n)t vajaae ta(n)tee tiau vaajeh ja(n)t janaa ||1||
798.e: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1||

799.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
799.t: jap man raam naam rasanaa ||
799.e: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, O mind.

799.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
799.t: masatak likhat likhe gur paiaa har hiradhai har basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
799.e: According to the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead, I have found the Guru, and the Lord abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

799.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
799.t: maiaa girasat bhramat hai praanee rakh levahu jan apanaa ||
799.e: Entangled in Maya, the mortal wanders around. Save Your humble servant, O Lord,

799.g: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਹਰਣਾਖਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
799.t: jiau prahilaadh haranaakhas grasio har raakhio har saranaa ||2||
799.e: as you saved Prahlaad from the clutches of Harnaakash; keep him in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||

799.g: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਾ ॥
799.t: kavan kavan kee gat mit kaheeaai har ke'ee patit pava(n)naa ||
799.e: How can I describe the state and the condition, O Lord, of those many sinners you have purified?

799.g: ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
799.t: oh ddovai ddor haath cham chamare har udhario pario saranaa ||3||
799.e: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, who worked with hides and carried dead animals was saved, by entering the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

799.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ ॥
799.t: prabh dheen dhiaal bhagat bhav taaran ham paapee raakh papanaa ||
799.e: O God, Merciful to the meek, carry Your devotees across the world-ocean; I am a sinner - save me from sin!

799.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
799.t: har dhaasan dhaas dhaas ham kareeahu jan naanak dhaas dhaasa(n)naa ||4||1||
799.e: O Lord, make me the slave of the slave of Your slaves; servant Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||

799.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
799.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
799.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

799.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
799.t: ham moorakh mugadh agiaan matee saranaagat purakh ajanamaa ||
799.e: I am foolish, idiotic and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, O Primal Being, O Lord beyond birth.

799.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
799.t: kar kirapaa rakh levahu mere Thaakur ham paathar heen akaramaa ||1||
799.e: Have Mercy upon me, and save me, O my Lord and Master; I am a lowly stone, with no good karma at all. ||1||

799.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
799.t: mere man bhaj raam naamai raamaa ||
799.e: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord, the Name of the Lord.

799.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
799.t: gurmat har ras paieeaai hor tiaagahu nihafal kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
799.e: Under Guru's Instructions, obtain the sublime, subtle essence of the Lord; renounce other fruitless actions. ||1||Pause||

799.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ ॥
799.t: har jan sevak se har taare ham niragun raakh upamaa ||
799.e: The humble servants of the Lord are saved by the Lord; I am worthless - it is Your glory to save me.

799.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥੨॥
799.t: tujh bin avar na koiee mere Thaakur har japeeaai vadde kara(n)maa ||2||
799.e: I have no other than You, O my Lord and Master; I meditate on the Lord, by my good karma. ||2||

799.g: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਵਡ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ॥
799.t: naamaheen dhirag jeevate tin vadd dhookh saha(n)maa ||
799.e: Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, their lives are cursed, and they must endure terrible pain.

799.g: ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
799.t: oi fir fir jon bhavaie'eeh ma(n)dhabhaagee mooR akaramaa ||3||
799.e: They are consigned to reincarnation over and over again; they are the most unfortunate fools, with no good karma at all. ||3||

799.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
799.t: har jan naam adhaar hai dhur poorab likhe vadd karamaa ||
799.e: The Naam is the Support of the Lord's humble servants; their good karma is pre-ordained.

799.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨੰਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
799.t: gur satigur naam dhiraRaiaa jan naanak safal jana(n)maa ||4||2||
799.e: The Guru, the True Guru, has implanted the Naam within servant Nanak, and his life is fruitful. ||4||2||

799.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
799.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
799.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

799.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੁਭਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
799.t: hamaraa chit lubhat moh bikhiaa bahu dhuramat mail bharaa ||
799.e: My consciousness is lured by emotional attachment and corruption; is is filled with evil-minded filth.

799.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
799.t: tum(h)ree sevaa kar na sakeh prabh ham kiau kar mugadh taraa ||1||
799.e: I cannot serve You, O God; I am ignorant - how can I cross over? ||1||

799.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
799.t: mere man jap narahar naam naraharaa ||
799.e: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord of man.

799.g: ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
799.t: jan uoopar kirapaa prabh dhaaree mil satigur paar paraa ||1|| rahaau ||
799.e: God has showered His Mercy upon His humble servant; meeting with the True Guru, he is carried across. ||1||Pause||

799.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
799.t: hamare pitaa Thaakur prabh suaamee har dheh matee jas karaa ||
799.e: O my Father, my Lord and Master, Lord God, please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Praises.

799.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
799.t: tum(h)rai sa(n)g lage se udhare jiau sa(n)g kaasaT loh taraa ||2||
799.e: Those who are attached to You are saved, like iron which is carried across with wood. ||2||

799.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
799.t: saakat nar hochhee mat madhim jin(h) har har sev na karaa ||
799.e: The faithless cynics have little or no understanding; they do not serve the Lord, Har, Har.

799.g: ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
799.t: te nar bhaagaheen dhuhachaaree oi janam mue fir maraa ||3||
799.e: Those beings are unfortunate and vicious; they die, and are consigned to reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

799.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਨੑਾਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਾ ॥
799.t: jin kau tum(h) har melahu suaamee te n(h)aae sa(n)tokh gur saraa ||
799.e: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O Lord and Master, bathe in the Guru's cleansing pool of contentment.

799.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
799.t: dhuramat mail giee har bhajiaa jan naanak paar paraa ||4||3||
799.e: Vibrating upon the Lord, the filth of their evil-mindedness is washed away; servant Nanak is carried across. ||4||3||

799.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
799.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
799.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

799.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
799.t: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee mil har har kathaa karahu ||
799.e: Come, O Saints, and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; let us tell the Stories of the Lord, Har, Har.

799.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
799.t: har har naam bohith hai kalajug khevaT gur sabadh tarahu ||1||
799.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the boat in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman to ferry us across. ||1||

799.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹੁ ॥
799.t: mere man har gun har ucharahu ||
799.e: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

799.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
799.t: masatak likhat likhe gun gaae mil sa(n)gat paar parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
799.e: According to the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon your forehead, sing the Praises of the Lord; join the Holy Congregation, and cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

800.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
800.t: kaiaa nagar meh raam ras uootam kiau paieeaai upadhes jan karahu ||
800.e: Within the body-village is the Lord's supreme, sublime essence. How can I obtain it? Teach me, O humble Saints.

800.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
800.t: satigur sev safal har dharasan mil a(n)mrit har ras peeahu ||2||
800.e: Serving the True Guru, you shall obtain the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan; meeting Him, drink in the ambrosial essence of the Lord's Nectar. ||2||

800.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
800.t: har har naam a(n)mrit har meeThaa har sa(n)tahu chaakh dhikhahu ||
800.e: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so sweet; O Saints of the Lord, taste it, and see.

800.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
800.t: gurmat har ras meeThaa laagaa tin bisare sabh bikh rasahu ||3||
800.e: Under Guru's Instruction, the Lord's essence seems so sweet; through it, all corrupt sensual pleasures are forgotten. ||3||

800.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
800.t: raam naam ras raam rasain har sevahu sa(n)t janahu ||
800.e: The Name of the Lord is the medicine to cure all diseases; so serve the Lord, O humble Saints.

800.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
800.t: chaar padhaarath chaare paae gurmat naanak har bhajahu ||4||4||
800.e: The four great blessings are obtained, O Nanak, by vibrating upon the Lord, under Guru's Instruction. ||4||4||

800.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
800.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
800.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

800.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
800.t: khatree braahaman soodh vais ko jaapai har ma(n)tr japainee ||
800.e: Anyone, from any class - Kh'shaatriya, Brahman, Soodra or Vaishya - can chant, and meditate on the Mantra of the Lord's Name.

800.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
800.t: gur satigur paarabraham kar poojahu nit sevahu dhinas sabh rainee ||1||
800.e: Worship the Guru, the True Guru, as the Supreme Lord God; serve Him constantly, all day and night. ||1||

800.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨੈਨੀ ॥
800.t: har jan dhekhahu satigur nainee ||
800.e: O humble servants of the Lord, behold the True Guru with your eyes.

800.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
800.t: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu har bolahu gurmat bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
800.e: Whatever you wish for, you shall receive, chanting the Word of the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

800.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
800.t: anik upaav chitave'eeh bahutere saa hovai j baat hovainee ||
800.e: People think of many and various efforts, but that alone happens, which is to happen.

800.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
800.t: apanaa bhalaa sabh koiee baachhai so kare j merai chit na chitainee ||2||
800.e: All beings seek goodness for themselves, but what the Lord does - that may not be what we think and expect. ||2||

800.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
800.t: man kee mat tiaagahu har jan ehaa baat kaThainee ||
800.e: So renounce the clever intellect of your mind, O humble servants of the Lord, no matter how hard this may be.

800.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
800.t: anadhin har har naam dhiaavahu gur satigur kee mat lainee ||3||
800.e: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; accept the wisdom of the Guru, the True Guru. ||3||

800.g: ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਜੰਤ ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
800.t: mat sumat terai vas suaamee ham ja(n)t too purakh ja(n)tainee ||
800.e: Wisdom, balanced wisdom is in Your power, O Lord and Master; I am the instrument, and You are the player, O Primal Lord.

800.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
800.t: jan naanak ke prabh karate suaamee jiau bhaavai tivai bulainee ||4||5||
800.e: O God, O Creator, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, as You wish, so do I speak. ||4||5||

800.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
800.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
800.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

800.g: ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
800.t: anadh mool dhiaaio purakhotam anadhin anadh ana(n)dhe ||
800.e: I meditate on the source of bliss, the Sublime Primal Being; night and day, I am in ecstasy and bliss.

800.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
800.t: dharam rai kee kaan chukaiee sabh chooke jam ke chha(n)dhe ||1||
800.e: The Righteous Judge of Dharma has no power over me; I have cast off all subservience to the Messenger of Death. ||1||

800.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
800.t: jap man har har naam guobi(n)dhe ||
800.e: Meditate, O mind, on the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

800.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
800.t: vaddabhaagee gur satigur paiaa gun gaae paramaana(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
800.e: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of supreme bliss. ||1||Pause||

800.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
800.t: saakat mooR maiaa ke badhik vich maiaa fireh fira(n)dhe ||
800.e: The foolish faithless cynics are held captive by Maya; in Maya, they continue wandering, wandering around.

800.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
800.t: tirasanaa jalat kirat ke baadhe jiau telee baladh bhava(n)dhe ||2||
800.e: Burnt by desire, and bound by the karma of their past actions, they go round and round, like the ox at the mill press. ||2||

800.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
800.t: gurmukh sev lage se udhare vaddabhaagee sev kara(n)dhe ||
800.e: The Gurmukhs, who focus on serving the Guru, are saved; by great good fortune, they perform service.

800.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
800.t: jin har japiaa tin fal paiaa sabh tooTe maiaa fa(n)dhe ||3||
800.e: Those who meditate on the Lord obtain the fruits of their rewards, and the bonds of Maya are all broken. ||3||

800.g: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
800.t: aape Thaakur aape sevak sabh aape aap govi(n)dhe ||
800.e: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant. The Lord of the Universe Himself is all by Himself.

800.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
800.t: jan naanak aape aap sabh varatai jiau raakhai tivai raha(n)dhe ||4||6||
800.e: O servant Nanak, He Himself is All-pervading; as He keeps us, we remain. ||4||6||

800.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
800.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
800.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

800.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੧੩ ॥
800.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ghar tayrvaa ||
800.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Partaal, Thirteenth House:

800.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਈਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥
800.t: bolahu bhieeaa raam naam patit paavano ||
800.e: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners.

800.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਾਰਨੋ ॥
800.t: har sa(n)t bhagat taarano ||
800.e: The Lord emancipates his Saints and devotees.
